```typescript
});

app.post('/api/internal/parents/import', (req, res) => {
  const { parent: src, mode } = req.body || {};
  if (!src || !src.email || !src.passwordHash) return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'parent invalide' });
  const email = String(src.email).trim().toLowerCase();
  pingSuspendu = true; // une importation venant du portail ne relance pas une synchronisation
  try {
    const store = getAccounts();
    const existant = store.parents.find((p) => p.email === email);
    if (mode === 'create') {
      if (existant) return res.status(409).json({ success: false, error: 'email-exists' });
      store.parents.push({
        id: `parent-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6)}`,
        email,
        nom: String(src.nom || '').trim().toUpperCase() || email,
        prenom: String(src.prenom || '').trim(),
        telephone: String(src.telephone || '').trim(),
        hash: String(src.passwordHash),
        salt: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
        secretQuestion: src.secretQuestion || 'Quel est le nom de votre premier animal de compagnie ?',
        secretAnswerHash: src.secretAnswerHash ? String(src.secretAnswerHash) : '',
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      } as ParentAccount);
      saveAccounts(store);
      console.log(`[parents-communs] compte parent ${email} créé depuis la Fiche Sanitaire`);
      return res.json({ success: true });
    }
    if (mode === 'password') {
      if (!existant) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'no-account' });
      existant.hash = String(src.passwordHash);
      if (src.secretAnswerHash) {
        existant.secretAnswerHash = String(src.secretAnswerHash);
        if (src.secretQuestion) existant.secretQuestion = src.secretQuestion;
      }
      saveAccounts(store);
      revokeSessionsOf('parent', existant.id);
      console.log(`[parents-communs] mot de passe du parent ${email} aligné sur la Fiche Sanitaire`);
      return res.json({ success: true });
    }
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'mode invalide' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  } finally {
    pingSuspendu = false;
  }
});

// 100% Server Draft Storage - AES-256 Encrypted, nothing stored in client cache or localStorage
// Un brouillon PAR COMPTE (data/drafts/<empreinte du compte>.enc) : un parent ne voit jamais le brouillon d'un autre.
const DRAFTS_DIR = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'drafts');
fs.mkdirSync(DRAFTS_DIR, { recursive: true });
// L'ancien brouillon unique (partagé entre tous les visiteurs) est supprimé : il exposait les données du dernier saisi
for (const legacy of [DRAFT_ENC_FILE, DRAFT_FILE]) {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(legacy)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(legacy);
      console.log('[securite] Ancien brouillon partagé supprimé :', path.basename(legacy));
    }
  } catch {}
}

function draftFileFor(req: express.Request): string {
  const auth = (req as any).auth as SessionInfo;
  const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${auth.role}:${auth.id}`).digest('hex');
  return path.join(DRAFTS_DIR, `${key}.enc`);
}

app.get('/api/draft', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const file = draftFileFor(req);
    if (fs.existsSync(file)) {
      const draft = decryptData(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8'));
      return res.json({ success: true, draft });
    }
    res.json({ success: true, draft: null });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post('/api/draft', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const enc = encryptData(req.body);
    fs.writeFileSync(draftFileFor(req), enc, 'utf-8');
    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Brouillon crypté sauvegardé sur le serveur' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.delete('/api/draft', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const file = draftFileFor(req);
    if (fs.existsSync(file)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(file);
    }
    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Brouillon supprimé du serveur' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Tree browser for local server archives:
// FICHES INFIRMERIE -> 2026-2027 -> 6A, 6B, etc. -> files
app.get('/api/nextcloud/tree', (req, res) => {
  function readFolderTree(dirPath: string, relativePath = ''): any {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dirPath)) return [];

    const entries = fs.readdirSync(dirPath, { withFileTypes: true });
    return entries.map((entry) => {
      const fullPath = path.join(dirPath, entry.name);
      const rel = path.join(relativePath, entry.name);

      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        return {
          name: entry.name,
          path: rel,
          type: 'folder',
          children: readFolderTree(fullPath, rel),
        };
      } else {
        const stats = fs.statSync(fullPath);
        return {
          name: entry.name,
          path: rel,
          type: 'file',
          size: stats.size,
          updatedAt: stats.mtime.toISOString(),
        };
      }
    });
  }

  const rootFolder = 'FICHES INFIRMERIE';
  let rootPath = path.join(ARCHIVES_DIR, rootFolder);
  if (!fs.existsSync(rootPath)) {
    rootPath = path.join(NEXTCLOUD_STORAGE_DIR, rootFolder);
  }
  if (!fs.existsSync(rootPath)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(rootPath, { recursive: true });
  }

  const tree = {
    name: rootFolder,
    path: rootFolder,
    type: 'folder',
    children: readFolderTree(rootPath, rootFolder),
  };

  res.json({
    success: true,
    storageType: 'local_server',
    storagePath: path.join(ARCHIVES_DIR, rootFolder),
    tree,
  });
});

app.get('/api/archives/tree', (req, res) => {
  res.redirect('/api/nextcloud/tree');
});

// Nextcloud config endpoint
app.get('/api/nextcloud/config', (req, res) => {
  res.json({
    success: true,
    data: {
      url: nextcloudConfig.url,
      username: nextcloudConfig.username,
      rootFolder: nextcloudConfig.rootFolder,
      enabled: nextcloudConfig.enabled,
      isCustomConfigured: nextcloudConfig.isCustomConfigured,
    },
  });
});

app.post('/api/nextcloud/config', async (req, res) => {
  const { url, username, appPassword, rootFolder, testConnection } = req.body;

  nextcloudConfig = {
    url: url || '',
    username: username || '',
    appPassword: appPassword !== undefined ? appPassword : nextcloudConfig.appPassword,
    rootFolder: rootFolder || 'FICHES INFIRMERIE',
    enabled: true,
    isCustomConfigured: !!(url && username),
  };

  fs.writeFileSync(CONFIG_FILE, JSON.stringify(nextcloudConfig, null, 2), 'utf-8');

  let testResult: { success: boolean; message: string } = {
    success: true,
    message: 'Configuration sauvegardée. Mode miroir local actif.',
  };

  if (testConnection && nextcloudConfig.isCustomConfigured && nextcloudConfig.appPassword) {
    try {
      const authHeader = 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(`${nextcloudConfig.username}:${nextcloudConfig.appPassword}`).toString('base64');
      const response = await fetch(nextcloudConfig.url, {
        method: 'PROPFIND',
        headers: {
          Authorization: authHeader,
          Depth: '0',
        },
      });

      if (response.ok || response.status === 207) {
        testResult = {
          success: true,
          message: 'Connexion WebDAV Nextcloud vérifiée avec succès !',
        };
      } else {
        testResult = {
          success: false,
          message: `Le serveur a répondu avec le code HTTP ${response.status} (${response.statusText})`,
        };
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      testResult = {
        success: false,
        message: `Impossible de joindre le serveur : ${e.message}`,
      };
    }
  }

  res.json({ success: true, config: nextcloudConfig, testResult });
});

// Download physical file from local server archives
app.get('/api/download-file', (req, res) => {
  const filePath = req.query.path as string;
  if (!filePath) {
    return res.status(400).send('Chemin manquant');
  }

  // Prevent path traversal : le fichier doit rester DANS les dossiers d'archives
  let absolutePath = safeResolve(ARCHIVES_DIR, filePath);
  if (!absolutePath || !fs.existsSync(absolutePath)) {
    absolutePath = safeResolve(NEXTCLOUD_STORAGE_DIR, filePath);
  }

  if (!absolutePath || !fs.existsSync(absolutePath) || !fs.statSync(absolutePath).isFile()) {
    return res.status(404).send('Fichier introuvable sur le serveur');
  }

  res.download(absolutePath);
});

// Purge all generated archive files and folders on server
app.post('/api/archives/purge', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const rootFolder = 'FICHES INFIRMERIE';
    const p1 = path.join(ARCHIVES_DIR, rootFolder);
    const p2 = path.join(NEXTCLOUD_STORAGE_DIR, rootFolder);

    if (fs.existsSync(p1)) {
      fs.rmSync(p1, { recursive: true, force: true });
      fs.mkdirSync(p1, { recursive: true });
    }
    if (fs.existsSync(p2)) {
      fs.rmSync(p2, { recursive: true, force: true });
      fs.mkdirSync(p2, { recursive: true });
    }

    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Tous les fichiers PDF archivés ont été purgés du serveur avec succès.' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Delete a single archive file
app.delete('/api/archives/file', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const filePath = req.query.path as string;
    if (!filePath) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Chemin manquant' });
    }

    const p1 = safeResolve(ARCHIVES_DIR, filePath);
    const p2 = safeResolve(NEXTCLOUD_STORAGE_DIR, filePath);

    let deleted = false;
    if (p1 && fs.existsSync(p1) && fs.statSync(p1).isFile()) {
      fs.unlinkSync(p1);
      deleted = true;
    }
    if (p2 && fs.existsSync(p2) && fs.statSync(p2).isFile()) {
      fs.unlinkSync(p2);
      deleted = true;
    }

    if (deleted) {
      res.json({ success: true, message: 'Fichier supprimé avec succès.' });
    } else {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'Fichier introuvable sur le serveur.' });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Stats for dashboard
app.get('/api/stats', (req, res) => {
  const fiches = getFiches();
  const total = fiches.length;
  const transmises = fiches.filter((f) => f.status === 'transmise_nextcloud').length;
  const erreurs = fiches.filter((f) => f.status === 'erreur_transmission').length;
  const signees = fiches.filter((f) => f.status === 'signee' || f.status === 'transmise_nextcloud').length;
  const carnetComplets = fiches.filter((f) => f.sante?.carnetVaccinations?.length > 0).length;

  res.json({
    success: true,
    stats: {
      total,
      transmises,
      erreurs,
      signees,
      carnetComplets,
    },
  });
});

// Serve RGPD specifications document
app.get('/CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md', (req, res) => {
  // Le nom de l'établissement est inséré à la volée (variable {{ETABLISSEMENT}})
  for (const f of CAHIER_FILES()) {
    if (fs.existsSync(f)) {
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8');
      return res.send(renderCahier(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8')));
    }
  }
  res.status(404).send('Document introuvable');
});

const RGPD_CONFIG_PATH = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'rgpd_config.json');

app.get('/api/rgpd/cahier-des-charges', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md');
    let markdown = '';
    if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      markdown = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
    } else {
      const publicPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(publicPath)) {
        markdown = fs.readFileSync(publicPath, 'utf-8');
      }
    }

    let config = null;
    if (fs.existsSync(RGPD_CONFIG_PATH)) {
      try {
        config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(RGPD_CONFIG_PATH, 'utf-8'));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error reading rgpd_config.json:', err);
      }
    }

    // Nom de l'établissement : toujours celui de l'identité enregistrée (gestion centralisée)
    if (config && typeof config === 'object') (config as any).etablissement = getSchoolBranding().schoolName;
    return res.json({ success: true, markdown: renderCahier(markdown), config });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post('/api/rgpd/cahier-des-charges', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { markdown, config } = req.body;
    if (typeof markdown !== 'string') {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Markdown invalide' });
    }

    const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md');
    const publicPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md');

    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, markdown, 'utf-8');
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(publicPath, markdown, 'utf-8');
    } catch {}

    if (config && typeof config === 'object') {
      const dataDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
      if (!fs.existsSync(dataDir)) fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(RGPD_CONFIG_PATH, JSON.stringify(config, null, 2), 'utf-8');
    }

    return res.json({ success: true, message: 'Cahier des charges RGPD mis à jour avec succès' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post('/api/rgpd/cahier-des-charges/reset', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const defaultPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD_DEFAULT.md');
    if (!fs.existsSync(defaultPath)) {
      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'Modèle par défaut introuvable' });
    }

    const defaultContent = fs.readFileSync(defaultPath, 'utf-8');
    const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md');
    const publicPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'CAHIER_DES_CHARGES_RGPD.md');

    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, defaultContent, 'utf-8');
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(publicPath, defaultContent, 'utf-8');
    } catch {}

    // Reset config file if present
    if (fs.existsSync(RGPD_CONFIG_PATH)) {
      try {
        fs.unlinkSync(RGPD_CONFIG_PATH);
      } catch {}
    }

    return res.json({ success: true, markdown: renderCahier(defaultContent), message: 'Réinitialisation au modèle officiel effectuée' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Vite dev middleware vs production static handler
async function start() {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    const vite = await createViteServer({
      server: { middlewareMode: true },
      appType: 'spa',
    });
    app.use(vite.middlewares);
  } else {
    const distPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist');
    app.use(express.static(distPath));
    app.get('*', (req, res) => {
      res.sendFile(path.join(distPath, 'index.html'));
    });
  }

  app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
    console.log(`Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  });
}

start();
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FicheInfirmerieData, INITIAL_FICHE_DATA, ParentProfile, SchoolBranding } from './types';
import { Header } from './components/Header';
import { StudentFormSection } from './components/StudentFormSection';

import { AuthorizationSection } from './components/AuthorizationSection';
import { ReviewModalOrStep } from './components/ReviewModalOrStep';
import { ConfirmationSuccess } from './components/ConfirmationSuccess';
import { AdminDashboard } from './components/AdminDashboard';
import { ParentAuthCard } from './components/ParentAuthCard';
import { AdminLoginCard } from './components/AdminLoginCard';
import { generateFichePDF, generateCarnetPDF } from './utils/pdfGenerator';
import { clearSession, SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT } from './utils/apiAuth';
import { setSchoolName, NOM_PAR_DEFAUT } from './utils/branding';
import {
  User,
  HeartPulse,
  FileCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Sparkles,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Shield,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function App() {
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'parent_form' | 'admin_dashboard'>('parent_form');
  const [parentProfile, setParentProfile] = useState<ParentProfile | null>(null);
  const [adminAuthenticated, setAdminAuthenticated] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [adminProfile, setAdminProfile] = useState<{ username: string; label?: string } | null>(null);
  const [schoolYear, setSchoolYear] = useState<string>('2026-2027');
  const [step, setStep] = useState<number>(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FicheInfirmerieData>(() => ({
    ...INITIAL_FICHE_DATA,
    schoolYear: '2026-2027',
  }));

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<{ type: 'error' | 'success' | 'info'; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submittedFiche, setSubmittedFiche] = useState<FicheInfirmerieData | null>(null);
  const [fichePdfBlob, setFichePdfBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [carnetPdfBlob, setCarnetPdfBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [branding, setBranding] = useState<SchoolBranding>({
    schoolName: NOM_PAR_DEFAUT,
    subTitle: "Sous-contrat d'Association avec l'État",
    logoDataUrl: '',
  });

  // Fetch school branding from server
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/branding')
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data.success && data.branding) {
          setBranding(data.branding);
          setSchoolName(data.branding.schoolName);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  // 100% Server Authoritative: brouillon DU PARENT CONNECTÉ (chargé uniquement après sa connexion)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!parentProfile) return;
    fetch('/api/draft')
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((resData) => {
        if (resData.success && resData.draft) {
          setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...resData.draft }));
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => console.log('Draft fetch error:', err));
  }, [parentProfile?.id]);

  // Session expirée côté serveur (redémarrage, inactivité > 8 h) : retour à l'écran de connexion
  useEffect(() => {
    const onExpired = () => {
      setAdminAuthenticated(false);
      setAdminProfile(null);
      setParentProfile(null);
      setNotification({ type: 'error', message: 'Votre session a expiré. Veuillez vous reconnecter.' });
    };
    window.addEventListener(SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT, onExpired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT, onExpired);
  }, []);

  // 100% Server Authoritative: Debounced sync draft to server (nothing stored in localStorage/browser cache)
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      // Autosave to server if a parent is connected and at least some student data is entered
      if (parentProfile && (formData.eleve.nom || formData.eleve.classe || formData.eleve.prenom)) {
        fetch('/api/draft', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(formData),
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
    }, 1200);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [formData]);

  // Keep schoolYear updated in form
  useEffect(() => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, schoolYear }));
  }, [schoolYear]);

  // Validation function per step
  const validateStep = (currentStep: number): boolean => {
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};

    if (currentStep === 0) {
      // Step 1: Eleve & Responsables
      if (!formData.eleve.classe) newErrors.classe = 'La classe est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.nom.trim()) newErrors.nom = 'Le nom de famille est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.prenom.trim()) newErrors.prenom = 'Le prénom est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.dateNaissance) newErrors.dateNaissance = 'La date de naissance est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.adresse.trim()) newErrors.adresse = "L'adresse est obligatoire.";
      if (!formData.eleve.codePostal.trim()) newErrors.codePostal = 'Le code postal est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.ville.trim()) newErrors.ville = 'La ville est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.nomMedecinTraitant.trim()) newErrors.nomMedecinTraitant = 'Le nom du médecin traitant est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.eleve.telMedecinTraitant.trim()) newErrors.telMedecinTraitant = 'Le téléphone du médecin traitant est obligatoire.';

      if (!formData.responsableLegal.nom.trim()) newErrors.nomResponsable = 'Le nom du responsable légal est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.responsableLegal.telPersonnel.trim()) newErrors.telPersonnelResponsable = 'Le numéro personnel est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.responsableLegal.telTravailMere.trim() && !formData.responsableLegal.telTravailMereNonConcerne) {
        newErrors.telTravailMere = 'Précisez un numéro ou cochez "Non concerné".';
      }
      if (!formData.responsableLegal.telTravailPere.trim() && !formData.responsableLegal.telTravailPereNonConcerne) {
        newErrors.telTravailPere = 'Précisez un numéro ou cochez "Non concerné".';
      }
    } else if (currentStep === 1) {
      // Step 2: Contact Urgence, Vaccinations & Allergies
      if (!formData.urgenceAccident.nomPrenom.trim()) newErrors.urgenceNomPrenom = 'Le contact d’urgence est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.urgenceAccident.telPersonnel.trim()) newErrors.urgenceTelPersonnel = 'Le téléphone d’urgence est obligatoire.';
      if (!formData.urgenceAccident.adresse.trim()) newErrors.urgenceAdresse = "L'adresse du contact d'urgence est obligatoire.";
      if (!formData.urgenceAccident.telTravail.trim() && !formData.urgenceAccident.telTravailNonConcerne) {
        newErrors.urgenceTelTravail = 'Précisez un numéro ou cochez "Non concerné".';
      }

      // Obligatory Vaccination Record copy
      if (!formData.sante.carnetVaccinations || formData.sante.carnetVaccinations.length === 0) {
        newErrors.carnetVaccinations = 'Le dépôt d’une copie du carnet de vaccinations est obligatoire.';
      }

      // Allergies
      if (!formData.sante.allergiesDifficultesSante.trim() && !formData.sante.aucuneAllergie) {
        newErrors.allergies = 'Veuillez préciser vos allergies ou cocher "Aucune allergie".';
      }
    } else if (currentStep === 2) {
      // Step 3: Authorization, Signature & GDPR
      if (!formData.autorisationParentale.soussigneNomPrenom.trim()) {
        newErrors.soussigne = 'Le nom et prénom du signataire sont obligatoires.';
      }
      if (!formData.autorisationParentale.accordPriseEnCharge) {
        newErrors.accordPriseEnCharge = "L'autorisation de prise en charge d'urgence est obligatoire.";
      }
      if (!formData.autorisationParentale.faitA.trim()) {
        newErrors.faitA = 'Le lieu est obligatoire.';
      }
      if (!formData.autorisationParentale.signatureDataUrl) {
        newErrors.signature = 'La signature électronique est obligatoire.';
      }
      if (!formData.consentementDonneesSante.accepteCollecteEtTransmission) {
        newErrors.consentement = 'Le consentement RGPD sur les données de santé est obligatoire.';
      }
    }

    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (validateStep(step)) {
      setErrors({});
      setStep((s) => s + 1);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 200, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  const handlePrev = () => {
    setErrors({});
    setStep((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1));
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  // Submit and upload to Nextcloud
  const handleFinalSubmit = async () => {
    if (!validateStep(2)) {
      setStep(2);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      // 1. Generate official PDFs on the fly
      const pdfFiche = await generateFichePDF(formData);
      const pdfCarnet = await generateCarnetPDF(formData);

      setFichePdfBlob(pdfFiche);
      setCarnetPdfBlob(pdfCarnet);

      // Convert to Base64 for the API
      const toBase64 = (blob: Blob): Promise<string> =>
        new Promise((resolve) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onloadend = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
          reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
        });

      const [pdfFicheBase64, pdfCarnetBase64] = await Promise.all([
        toBase64(pdfFiche),
        toBase64(pdfCarnet),
      ]);

      // 2. Post to backend
      const res = await fetch('/api/fiches', {
        method: 'POST',

          pdfFicheBase64,
          pdfCarnetBase64,

      });

      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        setSubmittedFiche(json.data);
        setStep(4); // Step 4 is success screen
        fetch('/api/draft', { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(() => {});
        setNotification({
          type: 'success',
          message: 'Fiche infirmerie validée et transmise avec succès !',

      } else {
        setNotification({
          type: 'error',
          message: `Erreur lors de l'enregistrement : ${json.error || 'Erreur inconnue'}`,

    } catch (err: any) {
      setNotification({
        type: 'error',
        message: `Erreur de transmission : ${err.message}`,

    const cctx = carnetCanvas.getContext('2d');

      cctx.lineWidth = 3;

        telTravailNonConcerne: true,
        adresse: '3 Avenue de Verdun, 94220 Charenton-le-Pont',
      },
      sante: {

          {

            name: 'Carnet_vaccinations_Thomas_Leclerc.jpg',

            size: 198000,
            dataUrl: fakeCarnet,
            uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },

        allergiesDifficultesSante: 'Légère intolérance au lactose. Aucun traitement régulier.',
        aucuneAllergie: false,
      },
      autorisationParentale: {
        soussigneNomPrenom: 'LECLERC Alexandre',
        qualite: 'pere',
        nomEnfant: 'Thomas LECLERC',
        accordPriseEnCharge: true,
        accordActesMedicaux: true,
        faitA: 'Charenton-le-Pont',
        faitLe: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR'),
        signatureDataUrl: fakeSig,
        mentionLuEtApprouve: true,
        signataireNomComplet: 'LECLERC Alexandre',
        dateHeureSignature: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      consentementDonneesSante: {
        accepteCollecteEtTransmission: true,
        dateConsentement: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      historique: [
        {
          date: new Date().toISOString(),
          action: 'Exemple démo pré-rempli',
        },
      ],
    });
    setErrors({});
  };

  const handleResetForm = () => {
    setFormData({ ...INITIAL_FICHE_DATA, schoolYear });
    setSubmittedFiche(null);
    setFichePdfBlob(null);
    setCarnetPdfBlob(null);
    setStep(0);
    fetch('/api/draft', { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(() => {});
  };

  const handleParentLoginSuccess = (profile: ParentProfile) => {
    setParentProfile(profile);
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      responsableLegal: {
        ...prev.responsableLegal,
        nom: prev.responsableLegal.nom || `${profile.nom} ${profile.prenom}`.trim(),
        telPersonnel: prev.responsableLegal.telPersonnel || profile.telephone,
      },
      autorisationParentale: {
        ...prev.autorisationParentale,
        soussigneNomPrenom: prev.autorisationParentale.soussigneNomPrenom || `${profile.nom} ${profile.prenom}`.trim(),
        signataireNomComplet: prev.autorisationParentale.signataireNomComplet || `${profile.nom} ${profile.prenom}`.trim(),
      },
    }));
    setNotification({
      type: 'success',
      message: `Bienvenue ${profile.prenom} ${profile.nom} ! Vous pouvez maintenant compléter la fiche de votre enfant.`,
    });
  };

  const handleParentLogout = () => {
    clearSession('parent');
    setParentProfile(null);
    // Le formulaire est vidé : le parent suivant sur le même appareil ne voit rien
    setFormData({ ...INITIAL_FICHE_DATA, schoolYear });
    setSubmittedFiche(null);
    setFichePdfBlob(null);
    setCarnetPdfBlob(null);
    setStep(0);
    setNotification({
      type: 'info',
      message: 'Vous avez été déconnecté de votre espace parent.',
    });
  };

  const handleAdminLoginSuccess = (admin: { username: string; label?: string; mustChangePassword?: boolean }) => {
    setAdminAuthenticated(true);
    setAdminProfile(admin);
    setNotification(
      admin.mustChangePassword
        ? {
            type: 'error',
            message: `Session ${admin.label || admin.username} ouverte — ⚠️ ce compte utilise encore le mot de passe initial : changez-le immédiatement (bouton « Mot de passe » du tableau de bord).`,
          }
        : {
            type: 'success',
            message: `Session ${admin.label || admin.username} ouverte avec succès.`,
          }
    );
  };

  const handleAdminLogout = () => {
    clearSession('staff');
    setAdminAuthenticated(false);
    setAdminProfile(null);
    setNotification({
      type: 'info',
      message: 'Session administrative fermée.',
    });
  };

  // Steps breadcrumb
  const stepsMetadata = [
    { label: 'Élève & Parents', icon: User, desc: 'Identité et contacts' },
    { label: 'Santé & Vaccins', icon: HeartPulse, desc: 'Urgences & carnet' },
    { label: 'Autorisation', icon: FileCheck, desc: 'Signature & RGPD' },
    { label: 'Vérification', icon: CheckCircle2, desc: 'Relecture intégrale' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans text-slate-800 antialiased selection:bg-blue-100 selection:text-blue-900">
      {/* Header with logo at top-left, session status, and 100% encryption badge */}
      <Header
        currentView={viewMode}
        onViewChange={(mode) => setViewMode(mode)}
        schoolYear={schoolYear}
        onSchoolYearChange={(year) => setSchoolYear(year)}
        parentProfile={parentProfile}
        onParentLogout={handleParentLogout}
        adminAuthenticated={adminAuthenticated}
        adminProfile={adminProfile}
        onAdminLogout={handleAdminLogout}
        branding={branding}
      />

      {/* Main Container */}
      <main className="flex-1 max-w-5xl w-full mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 py-4 sm:py-8">
        {notification && (
          <div
            className={`mb-4 p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between text-sm transition-all ${
              notification.type === 'error'
                ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-900'
                : notification.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900'
                : 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-900'
            }`}
          >
            <span>{notification.message}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setNotification(null)}
              className="ml-4 text-xs font-bold underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              Fermer
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* View Mode Switching: Admin vs Parent */}
        {viewMode === 'admin_dashboard' ? (
          !adminAuthenticated ? (
            <AdminLoginCard
              onSuccess={handleAdminLoginSuccess}
              onBackToParent={() => setViewMode('parent_form')}
            />
          ) : (
            <AdminDashboard
              schoolYear={schoolYear}
              onSchoolYearChange={(y) => setSchoolYear(y)}
              onOpenNewForm={() => {
                handleResetForm();
                setViewMode('parent_form');
              }}
              adminUser={adminProfile}
              branding={branding}
              onBrandingChange={(newB) => {
                setBranding(newB);
                setSchoolName(newB.schoolName);
              }}
            />
          )
        ) : (
          !parentProfile ? (
            <ParentAuthCard
              onSuccess={handleParentLoginSuccess}
              onSwitchToAdmin={() => setViewMode('admin_dashboard')}
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* Mode Banner & Quick Demo Pre-fill */}
            {step < 4 && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white p-3.5 px-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                  <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                  <span>
                    Formulaire conforme à la fiche infirmerie officielle de l’établissement • Tous les champs sont obligatoires
                  </span>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={loadDemoData}
                  className="text-xs bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Pré-remplit les champs avec un exemple complet pour tester immédiatement le formulaire"
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-700" />
                  <span>Pré-remplir avec un exemple d'élève</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Stepper Progress Bar (only during steps 0 to 3) */}
            {step < 4 && (
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-2xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 sm:gap-4">
                  {stepsMetadata.map((s, idx) => {
                    const Icon = s.icon;
                    const isActive = step === idx;
                    const isCompleted = step > idx;

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={idx}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (step > idx) setStep(idx);
                        }}
                        disabled={step < idx}
                        className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-left transition-all ${
                          isActive
                            ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-xs'
                            : isCompleted
                            ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 text-emerald-950 hover:bg-emerald-100/80 cursor-pointer'
                            : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div
                          className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-xs font-bold ${
                            isActive
                              ? 'bg-blue-800 text-white'
                              : isCompleted
                              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                              : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isCompleted ? '✓' : idx + 1}
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold truncate">{s.label}</p>
                          <p className={`text-[11px] truncate ${isActive ? 'text-blue-200' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                            {s.desc}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Errors alert if any */}
            {Object.keys(errors).length > 0 && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-900 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-3">
                <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Certains renseignements obligatoires sont incomplets :
                  </h4>
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-5 mt-1 text-xs space-y-0.5 text-rose-700">
                    {Object.values(errors).map((err, i) => (
                      <li key={i}>{err}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Step 0 : Élève & Responsables */}
            {step === 0 && (
              <StudentFormSection
                data={formData}
                onChange={setFormData}
                onNext={handleNext}
                errors={errors}
              />
            )}

            {/* Step 1 : Santé & Vaccinations */}
            {step === 1 && (
              <HealthFormSection
                data={formData}
                onChange={setFormData}
                onNext={handleNext}
                onPrev={handlePrev}
                errors={errors}
              />
            )}

            {/* Step 2 : Autorisation & Signature */}
            {step === 2 && (
              <AuthorizationSection
                data={formData}
                onChange={setFormData}
                onNext={handleNext}
                onPrev={handlePrev}
                errors={errors}
              />
            )}

            {/* Step 3 : Récapitulatif & Validation préalable */}
            {step === 3 && (
              <ReviewModalOrStep
                data={formData}
                onEditSection={(stepIdx) => setStep(stepIdx)}
                onFinalSubmit={handleFinalSubmit}
                isSubmitting={isSubmitting}
              />
            )}

            {/* Step 4 : Succès & Téléchargement */}
            {step === 4 && (
              <ConfirmationSuccess
                data={submittedFiche || formData}
                fichePdfBlob={fichePdfBlob}
                carnetPdfBlob={carnetPdfBlob}
                onReset={handleResetForm}
                onGoToAdmin={() => setViewMode('admin_dashboard')}
              />
            )}
          </div>
          )
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="bg-white border-t border-slate-200 mt-12 py-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 space-y-1">
          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
            {branding.schoolName} • Service Médical & Infirmerie
          </p>
          <p>
            Plateforme conforme RGPD • Archivage sécurisé • Fiches infirmerie & Carnets de vaccinations numérisés
          </p>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { FicheInfirmerieData, INITIAL_FICHE_DATA, NextcloudFileNode, SCHOOL_CLASSES, SCHOOL_YEARS, StaffProfile } from '../types';
import { getFicheFileName, getCarnetFileName, generateFichePDF, generateCarnetPDF } from '../utils/pdfGenerator';
import { FicheDocumentPreview } from './FicheDocumentPreview';
import { ClassManagementModal } from './ClassManagementModal';
import { EditStudentClassModal } from './EditStudentClassModal';
import { RgpdComplianceView } from './RgpdComplianceView';
import { ChangeStaffPasswordModal } from './ChangeStaffPasswordModal';
import { withStaffToken } from '../utils/apiAuth';
import { useSchoolName } from '../utils/branding';
import { SchoolBrandingModal } from './SchoolBrandingModal';
import { SchoolBranding } from '../types';
import {
  Search,
  RefreshCw,
  FileText,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Download,
  Eye,
  Folder,
  FolderOpen,
  File,
  Shield,
  ShieldCheck,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronDown,
  Users,
  Plus,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  School,
  FileCheck,
  Check,
  X,
  Info,
  KeyRound
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AdminDashboardProps {
  schoolYear: string;
  onSchoolYearChange: (year: string) => void;
  onOpenNewForm: () => void;
  adminUser?: StaffProfile | { username: string; label?: string } | null;
  branding?: SchoolBranding;
  onBrandingChange?: (newBranding: SchoolBranding) => void;
}

export function AdminDashboard({
  schoolYear,
  onSchoolYearChange,
  onOpenNewForm,
  adminUser,
  branding,
  onBrandingChange,
}: AdminDashboardProps) {
  const nomEtab = useSchoolName();
  const [fiches, setFiches] = useState<FicheInfirmerieData[]>([]);
  const [classesList, setClassesList] = useState<string[]>(SCHOOL_CLASSES);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState<string>('all');
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState<string>('all');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'by_class' | 'all_table' | 'archive_tree' | 'rgpd'>('by_class');

  // Accordion state for class by class view
  const [expandedClasses, setExpandedClasses] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  // Preview modal target (replaces broken iframe with authentic zero-error preview)
  const [previewTarget, setPreviewTarget] = useState<{
    fiche: FicheInfirmerieData;
    type: 'fiche' | 'carnet';
  } | null>(null);

  // Class Management Modals
  const [isClassModalOpen, setIsClassModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [renamingClass, setRenamingClass] = useState<{ oldName: string; newName: string } | null>(null);
  const [deletingClass, setDeletingClass] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPasswordModalOpen, setIsPasswordModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isBrandingModalOpen, setIsBrandingModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [studentToEditClass, setStudentToEditClass] = useState<FicheInfirmerieData | null>(null);

  // Archive Tree State
  const [archiveTree, setArchiveTree] = useState<NextcloudFileNode | null>(null);
  const [loadingTree, setLoadingTree] = useState(false);

  // Selected Fiche for detail modal
  const [selectedFicheDetail, setSelectedFicheDetail] = useState<FicheInfirmerieData | null>(null);
  const [retryingId, setRetryingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Load classes from API
  const fetchClasses = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/classes');
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success && Array.isArray(json.classes) && json.classes.length > 0) {
        setClassesList(json.classes);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error fetching classes:', e);
    }
  };

  // Load fiches from API
  const fetchFiches = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/fiches');
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        // Fiches incomplètes (anciennes ou partielles) complétées avec la structure par défaut :
        // l'affichage ne plante jamais sur une rubrique absente
        const normalized = (Array.isArray(json.data) ? json.data : []).map((f: any) => {
          const out: any = { ...INITIAL_FICHE_DATA, ...f };
          for (const k of Object.keys(INITIAL_FICHE_DATA) as (keyof FicheInfirmerieData)[]) {
            const def: any = INITIAL_FICHE_DATA[k];
            if (def && typeof def === 'object' && !Array.isArray(def)) out[k] = { ...def, ...(f?.[k] || {}) };
          }
          out.historique = Array.isArray(f?.historique) ? f.historique : [];
          return out as FicheInfirmerieData;
        });
        setFiches(normalized);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error fetching fiches:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load folder tree
  const fetchArchiveTree = async () => {
    setLoadingTree(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/nextcloud/tree');
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        setArchiveTree(json.tree);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error fetching tree:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingTree(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClasses();
    fetchFiches();
    fetchArchiveTree();
  }, []);

  // Purge all archived files on server
  const handlePurgeArchives = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Êtes-vous sûr de vouloir PURGER tous les fichiers PDF et carnets archivés sur le serveur ? Cette action supprimera définitivement les fichiers stockés dans le dossier FICHES INFIRMERIE.')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/archives/purge', { method: 'POST' });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        alert(json.message || 'Archives purgées avec succès.');
        await fetchArchiveTree();
      } else {
        alert(json.error || 'Erreur lors de la purge.');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert('Impossible de purger les archives : ' + e.message);
    }
  };

  // Delete a single archive file
  const handleDeleteArchiveFile = async (filePath: string, fileName: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Supprimer le document "${fileName}" du serveur ?`)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/archives/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        await fetchArchiveTree();
      } else {
        alert(json.error || 'Erreur lors de la suppression.');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert('Impossible de supprimer le fichier : ' + e.message);
    }
  };

  // Class Management Handlers
  const handleClassCreated = async (name: string) => {
    const res = await fetch('/api/classes', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name }),
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.error || 'Erreur création classe');
    setClassesList(json.classes);
  };

  const handleClassRenamed = async (oldName: string, newName: string) => {
    const res = await fetch('/api/classes/rename', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ oldName, newName }),
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.error || 'Erreur renommage classe');
    setClassesList(json.classes);
    await fetchFiches();
  };

  const handleClassDeleted = async (name: string) => {
    const res = await fetch('/api/classes/delete', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name }),
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.error || 'Erreur suppression classe');
    setClassesList(json.classes);
    await fetchFiches();
  };

  const handleStudentClassUpdated = async (ficheId: string, newClass: string) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/fiches/${ficheId}/classe`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ classe: newClass }),
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.error || 'Erreur modification classe élève');
    await fetchFiches();
  };

  // Delete single fiche
  const handleDeleteFiche = async (fiche: FicheInfirmerieData) => {
    const studentName = `${fiche.eleve?.nom || ''} ${fiche.eleve?.prenom || ''}`.trim();
    if (!window.confirm(`Supprimer définitivement la fiche infirmerie de "${studentName}" ?`)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/fiches/${fiche.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        await fetchFiches();
      } else {
        alert(json.error || 'Erreur lors de la suppression.');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert('Impossible de supprimer la fiche : ' + e.message);
    }
  };

  // Purge all fiches
  const handlePurgeAllFiches = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Êtes-vous sûr de vouloir PURGER TOUTES les fiches infirmerie enregistrées ? Cette opération effacera la liste complète des élèves enregistrés.')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/fiches/purge', { method: 'POST' });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        alert('Toutes les fiches infirmerie ont été purgées avec succès.');
        await fetchFiches();
      } else {
        alert(json.error || 'Erreur lors de la purge.');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert('Impossible de purger les fiches : ' + e.message);
    }
  };

  // Filter fiches
  const filteredFiches = useMemo(() => {
    return fiches.filter((fiche) => {
      // School year filter
      if (fiche.schoolYear && fiche.schoolYear !== schoolYear) {
        return false;
      }

      // Class filter
      if (selectedClass !== 'all' && fiche.eleve?.classe !== selectedClass) {
        return false;
      }

      // Status filter
      if (selectedStatus !== 'all') {
        if (selectedStatus === 'archive' && fiche.status !== 'transmise_nextcloud') return false;
        if (selectedStatus === 'signee' && !fiche.autorisationParentale?.signatureDataUrl) return false;
        if (selectedStatus === 'attente' && fiche.status === 'transmise_nextcloud') return false;
      }

      // Search query
      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const nom = (fiche.eleve?.nom || '').toLowerCase();
        const prenom = (fiche.eleve?.prenom || '').toLowerCase();
        const classe = (fiche.eleve?.classe || '').toLowerCase();
        const medecin = (fiche.eleve?.nomMedecinTraitant || '').toLowerCase();
        const resp = (fiche.responsableLegal?.nom || '').toLowerCase();

        return (
          nom.includes(q) ||
          prenom.includes(q) ||
          classe.includes(q) ||
          medecin.includes(q) ||
          resp.includes(q)
        );
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [fiches, schoolYear, selectedClass, selectedStatus, searchTerm]);

  // Group fiches by class for "Classe par classe" view
  const fichesByClass = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, FicheInfirmerieData[]> = {};

    // First, populate all known classes
    classesList.forEach((cl) => {
      map[cl] = [];
    });

    // Place fiches in their respective classes
    filteredFiches.forEach((f) => {
      const cl = f.eleve?.classe?.trim() || 'Non assignée';
      if (!map[cl]) {
        map[cl] = [];
      }
      map[cl].push(f);
    });

    // Sort students alphabetically inside each class by NOM, then PRENOM
    Object.keys(map).forEach((cl) => {
      map[cl].sort((a, b) => {
        const nameA = `${a.eleve?.nom || ''} ${a.eleve?.prenom || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        const nameB = `${b.eleve?.nom || ''} ${b.eleve?.prenom || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        return nameA.localeCompare(nameB);
      });
    });

    return map;
  }, [classesList, filteredFiches]);

  // Toggle class accordion
  const toggleClassExpand = (className: string) => {
    setExpandedClasses((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [className]: !prev[className],
    }));
  };

  const expandAllClasses = () => {
    const next: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    Object.keys(fichesByClass).forEach((cl) => {
      next[cl] = true;
    });
    setExpandedClasses(next);
  };

  const collapseAllClasses = () => {
    setExpandedClasses({});
  };

  // Download PDF helper
  const handleDownloadPDF = async (fiche: FicheInfirmerieData, type: 'fiche' | 'carnet') => {
    try {
      let blob: Blob;
      let title: string;
      if (type === 'fiche') {
        blob = await generateFichePDF(fiche);
        title = getFicheFileName(fiche);
      } else {
        blob = await generateCarnetPDF(fiche);
        title = getCarnetFileName(fiche);
      }
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = title;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Erreur génération PDF : ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  // Export CSV
  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    if (filteredFiches.length === 0) return;

    const headers = [
      'Classe',
      'Nom',
      'Prénom',
      'Date de naissance',
      'Adresse',
      'CP',
      'Ville',
      'Médecin traitant',
      'Tél Médecin',
      'Responsable Légal',
      'Statut Responsable',
      'Tél Perso Responsable',
      'Tél Pro Mère',
      'Tél Pro Père',
      'Contact Urgence',
      'Tél Urgence',
      'Vaccins à jour',
      'Carnet joint',
      'Allergies / Difficultés',
      'Fiche Signée',
      'Date Signature',
      'Statut Archivage',
    ];

    const rows = filteredFiches.map((f) => [
      `"${f.eleve.classe || ''}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.nom || ''}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.prenom || ''}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.dateNaissance || ''}"`,
      `"${(f.eleve.adresse || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.codePostal || ''}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.ville || ''}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.nomMedecinTraitant || ''}"`,
      `"${f.eleve.telMedecinTraitant || ''}"`,
      `"${(f.responsableLegal.nom || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${f.responsableLegal.statut || ''}"`,
      `"${f.responsableLegal.telPersonnel || ''}"`,
      `"${f.responsableLegal.telTravailMere || ''}"`,
      `"${f.responsableLegal.telTravailPere || ''}"`,
      `"${(f.urgenceAccident.nomPrenom || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${f.urgenceAccident.telPersonnel || ''}"`,
      `"${f.sante.vaccinations.antipoliomyelitique.status === 'a_jour' ? 'OUI' : 'NON'}"`,
      `"${(f.sante.carnetVaccinations || []).length > 0 ? 'OUI' : 'NON'}"`,
      `"${(f.sante.allergiesDifficultesSante || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${f.autorisationParentale?.signatureDataUrl ? 'OUI' : 'NON'}"`,
      `"${f.autorisationParentale?.dateHeureSignature ? new Date(f.autorisationParentale.dateHeureSignature).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR') : ''}"`,
      `"${f.status === 'transmise_nextcloud' ? 'Archivée' : 'En attente'}"`,
    ]);

    const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,\uFEFF' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(','))].join('\n');
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute('download', `fiches_infirmerie_${schoolYear}_export.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  // Summary counts
  const signedCount = filteredFiches.filter((f) => !!f.autorisationParentale?.signatureDataUrl).length;
  const carnetCount = filteredFiches.filter((f) => (f.sante.carnetVaccinations || []).length > 0).length;
  const archivedCount = filteredFiches.filter((f) => f.status === 'transmise_nextcloud').length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Header & Stat Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-5">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-950">
              <School className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-900" />
              <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">
                Portail d'Administration de l'Infirmerie
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
              {nomEtab} • Année {schoolYear}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsBrandingModalOpen(true)}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-950 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-blue-300 shadow-2xs"
              title="Modifier le nom officiel de l'établissement et téléverser votre logo"
            >
              <School className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700" />
              <span>Identité & Logo</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsPasswordModalOpen(true)}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-950 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-emerald-300 shadow-2xs"
              title="Modifier le mot de passe de la session active"
            >
              <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
              <span>Mot de passe</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsClassModalOpen(true)}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-slate-300"
            >
              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-900" />
              <span>Gérer les Classes</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportCSV}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-slate-300"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <span>Exporter CSV</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenNewForm}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Nouvelle Fiche</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                fetchFiches();
                fetchClasses();
                fetchArchiveTree();
              }}
              className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-950 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-slate-200"
              title="Rafraîchir les données"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Metrics Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 pt-5">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 font-semibold mb-1">
              <span>Total Élèves</span>
              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-900" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{filteredFiches.length}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{classesList.length} classes configurées</p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-emerald-50/60 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-emerald-800 font-semibold mb-1">
              <span>Signatures Validées</span>
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-950">{signedCount}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 mt-0.5">
              {filteredFiches.length > 0 ? Math.round((signedCount / filteredFiches.length) * 100) : 0}% des élèves
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-blue-50/60 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-blue-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-blue-900 font-semibold mb-1">
              <span>Carnets Reçus</span>
              <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-950">{carnetCount}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-blue-700 mt-0.5">
              {filteredFiches.length > 0 ? Math.round((carnetCount / filteredFiches.length) * 100) : 0}% conformes
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-600 font-semibold mb-1">
              <span>Archivées & Protégées</span>
              <FileCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{archivedCount}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Stockage infirmerie</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs Navigation */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-2 shadow-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('by_class')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'by_class'
                ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Vue Classe par Classe (Recommandé)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('all_table')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'all_table'
                ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Tous les élèves (Vue à plat)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('archive_tree')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'archive_tree'
                ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            <Folder className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Stockage & Fichiers Locaux (LXC)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('rgpd')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'rgpd'
                ? 'bg-emerald-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Cahier des Charges RGPD & CNIL</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Global Search & Class Filter */}
        {(activeTab === 'by_class' || activeTab === 'all_table') && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto px-2">
            <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-64">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Rechercher élève, médecin..."
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900"
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {activeTab === 'by_class' && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={expandAllClasses}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-blue-950 font-bold hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Déplier toutes les classes"
                >
                  Tout déplier
                </button>
                <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={collapseAllClasses}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Replier toutes les classes"
                >
                  Tout replier
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Purge all student fiches button */}
            {fiches.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handlePurgeAllFiches}
                className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 hover:text-white bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-600 border border-rose-200 hover:border-rose-600 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                title="Purger toutes les fiches d'élèves enregistrées"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Purger les fiches</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: CLASSE PAR CLASSE (Core User Requirement) */}
      {activeTab === 'by_class' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {Object.keys(fichesByClass).length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-12 text-center text-slate-500">
              <School className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-3" />
              <p className="font-bold text-base text-slate-700">Aucune classe trouvée</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Créez votre première classe pour commencer.</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsClassModalOpen(true)}
                className="mt-4 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-950 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> Créer une classe
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            Object.entries(fichesByClass).map(([className, classStudents]) => {
              const isExpanded = !!expandedClasses[className];
              const totalInClass = classStudents.length;
              const signedInClass = classStudents.filter((f) => !!f.autorisationParentale?.signatureDataUrl).length;
              const carnetInClass = classStudents.filter((f) => (f.sante.carnetVaccinations || []).length > 0).length;

              return (
                <div
                  key={className}
                  className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-xs transition-shadow hover:shadow-md"
                >
                  {/* Class Header Bar (Clicking on it expands/collapses the students list) */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => toggleClassExpand(className)}
                    className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50/80 hover:bg-slate-100/80 cursor-pointer flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 select-none transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-blue-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0">
                        {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-blue-950 tracking-tight">
                            Classe de {className}
                          </h2>
                          <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-blue-100 text-blue-950 font-bold text-xs rounded-full border border-blue-200">
                            {totalInClass} {totalInClass > 1 ? 'élèves' : 'élève'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                          {totalInClass > 0
                            ? `${signedInClass} signée(s) • ${carnetInClass} carnet(s) joint(s) — Cliquez pour ${isExpanded ? 'replier' : 'afficher'} la liste`
                            : 'Aucun élève enregistré dans cette classe'}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Class indicators & quick actions */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setRenamingClass({ oldName: className, newName: className });
                        }}
                        className="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-950 hover:bg-white rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200"
                        title={`Modifier la classe "${className}"`}
                      >
                        <Edit2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setDeletingClass(className);
                        }}
                        className="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-white rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200"
                        title={`Supprimer la classe "${className}"`}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => toggleClassExpand(className)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        <span>{isExpanded ? 'Masquer' : 'Voir les élèves'}</span>
                        {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Expanded Student List */}
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <div className="p-0 overflow-x-auto">
                      {classStudents.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                          Aucun élève n'est encore enregistré dans la classe de {className}.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-slate-100/60 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                              <th className="py-3 px-4">Élève & Identité</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4">Parents / Urgence</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4">Médecin</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Fiche</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Carnet</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Signature</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Archivage</th>
                              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                            {classStudents.map((fiche) => {
                              const isComplete = !!fiche.eleve?.nom && !!fiche.eleve?.prenom && !!fiche.eleve?.classe;
                              const hasCarnet = (fiche.sante.carnetVaccinations || []).length > 0;
                              const isSigned = !!fiche.autorisationParentale?.signatureDataUrl;

                              return (
                                <tr key={fiche.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50/40 transition-colors">
                                  {/* Student Name */}
                                  <td className="py-3 px-4">
                                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                                      {fiche.eleve.nom.toUpperCase()} {fiche.eleve.prenom}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                      Né(e) le {fiche.eleve.dateNaissance || '-'}
                                    </div>
                                  </td>

                                  {/* Parents */}
                                  <td className="py-3 px-4">
                                    <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                                      {fiche.responsableLegal.nom}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[11px] text-blue-900 font-medium">
                                      {fiche.responsableLegal.telPersonnel || '-'}
                                    </div>
                                  </td>

                                  {/* Doctor */}
                                  <td className="py-3 px-4">
                                    <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                                      Dr {fiche.eleve.nomMedecinTraitant || '-'}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                      {fiche.eleve.telMedecinTraitant || '-'}
                                    </div>
                                  </td>

                                  {/* Fiche Status */}
                                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
                                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Complète
                                    </span>
                                  </td>

                                  {/* Carnet Status */}
                                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                                    {hasCarnet ? (
                                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
                                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> {fiche.sante.carnetVaccinations?.length} doc(s)
                                      </span>
                                    ) : (
                                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800">
                                        <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" /> Manquant
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </td>

                                  {/* Signature */}
                                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                                    {isSigned ? (
                                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
                                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Signée
                                      </span>
                                    ) : (

                                    </span>
                                  </td>

                                          <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />
                                        </button>
                                      )}

                                      {/* Direct PDF Download */}
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => handleDownloadPDF(fiche, 'fiche')}
                                        className="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                        title="Télécharger le PDF A4"
                                      >
                                        <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                                      </button>

                                      {/* Change student's class */}
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => setStudentToEditClass(fiche)}
                                        className="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"

                                        <School className="w-4 h-4" />
                                      </button>

                                      {/* Details modal */}
                                      <button
                                        type="button"

                                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                      </button>
                                    </div>
                                  </td>
                                </tr>
                              );
                            })}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      )}

      {/* TAB 2: FLAT TABLE VIEW */}

                      {fiche.responsableLegal.nom} ({fiche.responsableLegal.telPersonnel})

                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-700">

                        </span>

                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">

                          <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"

                          <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setStudentToEditClass(fiche)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"

                          <School className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"

                        </button>
                      </div>
```
