```tsx
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-blue-950 uppercase tracking-tight">

                </h2>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">

                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 font-mono text-xs shadow-inner max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto">
              {archiveTree ? (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">

                    <span>{archiveTree.name} / (Dossier racine local)</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pl-4 space-y-2 border-l border-slate-800 ml-2">
                    {(archiveTree.children || []).map((yearNode) => (
                      <div key={yearNode.name} className="space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-300 font-bold">
                          <Folder className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />

                        <div className="pl-5 space-y-2 border-l border-slate-800 ml-2">

                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                                <Folder className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                                <span>Classe {classNode.name} / ({classNode.children?.length || 0} document(s))</span>

                              <div className="pl-5 space-y-1 border-l border-slate-800 ml-2">
                                {(classNode.children || []).length === 0 ? (
                                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 italic">

                                  </span>

                                      key={fileNode.name}

                                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-white truncate">

                                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 shrink-0">
                                            ({Math.round(fileNode.size / 1024)} Ko)
                                          </span>
                                        )}
                                      </div>

                                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                        <a

                                          title={`Supprimer ${fileNode.name} du serveur`}

                                          <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />

                                      </div>

              )}

                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-blue-950">

                </h3>
              </div>
              <button

            <div className="space-y-3">

              </p>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold mb-1">

                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoFocus
                  value={renamingClass.newName}
                  onChange={(e) => setRenamingClass({ ...renamingClass, newName: e.target.value })}
                  onKeyDown={async (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      if (renamingClass.newName.trim() && renamingClass.newName.trim() !== renamingClass.oldName) {
                        try {
                          await handleClassRenamed(renamingClass.oldName, renamingClass.newName.trim());
                          setRenamingClass(null);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(err.message);
                        }
                      } else {
                        setRenamingClass(null);
                      }
                    }
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') setRenamingClass(null);
                  }}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none text-slate-900 font-semibold"
                />

              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">

              >

              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={async () => {
                  if (renamingClass.newName.trim() && renamingClass.newName.trim() !== renamingClass.oldName) {

                <Check className="w-4 h-4" />

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-3">

      )}

      {/* School Branding & Logo Modal */}
      {isBrandingModalOpen && (
        <SchoolBrandingModal
          isOpen={isBrandingModalOpen}
          branding={branding}
          onClose={() => setIsBrandingModalOpen(false)}
          onSaved={(newB) => {
            if (onBrandingChange) onBrandingChange(newB);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Fiche Detail & Audit Log Modal */}
      {selectedFicheDetail && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-blue-950">
                Historique et Traçabilité • {selectedFicheDetail.eleve.nom.toUpperCase()} {selectedFicheDetail.eleve.prenom}
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedFicheDetail(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 block uppercase">Journal des actions :</span>
              <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                {(selectedFicheDetail.historique || []).map((h, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="text-[11px] flex items-start gap-2">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0 font-mono">
                      {new Date(h.date).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')} {new Date(h.date).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR')}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700 font-medium">{h.action}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedFicheDetail(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold"
              >
                Fermer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/AdminLoginCard.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/AdminLoginCard.tsx -->
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useSchoolName } from '../utils/branding';
import {
  Lock,
  Shield,
  KeyRound,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Info,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  ChevronLeft
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AdminLoginCardProps {
  onSuccess: (admin: { username: string; label?: string; mustChangePassword?: boolean }) => void;
  onBackToParent: () => void;
}

export function AdminLoginCard({ onSuccess, onBackToParent }: AdminLoginCardProps) {
  const nomEtab = useSchoolName();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('admin');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!username.trim() || !password) {
      setErrorMsg('Veuillez saisir votre identifiant et votre mot de passe.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/admin/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          username: username.trim(),
          password,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success && data.admin) {
        onSuccess({ ...data.admin, mustChangePassword: !!data.mustChangePassword });
      } else {
        setErrorMsg(data.error || 'Identifiant ou mot de passe incorrect.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg('Erreur de connexion : ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto py-6 sm:py-12 px-3 sm:px-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-md overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header Institutionnel Admin */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950 via-slate-900 to-blue-950 text-white p-6 sm:p-8 text-center relative">
          <div className="flex justify-center mb-3">
            <img
              src="/logo.svg"
              alt={`Logo ${nomEtab}`}
              className="h-16 w-auto object-contain bg-white/10 p-2 rounded-xl backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-900/60 border border-blue-700/60 text-blue-200 text-xs font-semibold mb-2">
            <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-300" />
            <span>Portail Infirmerie & Direction</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
            Accès Sécurisé Administration
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-1">
            {nomEtab}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-7 space-y-4 text-xs">
          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-xs flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{errorMsg}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick Session Switcher Buttons */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold">
              Choisir la session à ouvrir :
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUsername('admin')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  username.toLowerCase() === 'admin'
                    ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white border-blue-950 shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                }`}
              >
                <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Direction (admin)</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUsername('infirmerie')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  username.toLowerCase() === 'infirmerie'
                    ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white border-blue-950 shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                }`}
              >
                <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Infirmerie (infirmerie)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4 pt-1">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold mb-1.5">
                Identifiant de Session
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={username}
                  onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="admin ou infirmerie"
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 text-slate-900 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold mb-1.5">
                Mot de passe de la session
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
                <input
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••••••"
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-10 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 text-slate-900 text-xs"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full py-3 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 mt-2"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <span>Vérification sécurisée...</span>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Se connecter au tableau de bord</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Back button */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 p-3.5 text-center">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onBackToParent}
            className="text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-950 font-semibold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mx-auto cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Retour à l'espace parent (Formulaire)</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
<!-- SCRIPT-END:apps/infirmerie/src/components/AdminLoginCard.tsx -->

```tsx
import { FicheInfirmerieData } from '../types';
import { SignaturePad } from './SignaturePad';
import { useSchoolName } from '../utils/branding';
import { FileCheck, Shield, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface AuthorizationSectionProps {
  data: FicheInfirmerieData;
  onChange: (updater: (prev: FicheInfirmerieData) => FicheInfirmerieData) => void;
  onNext: () => void;
  onPrev: () => void;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
}

export function AuthorizationSection({ data, onChange, onNext, onPrev, errors }: AuthorizationSectionProps) {
  const nomEtab = useSchoolName();
  const updateAuth = (field: keyof FicheInfirmerieData['autorisationParentale'], value: any) => {
    onChange((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      autorisationParentale: { ...prev.autorisationParentale, [field]: value },
    }));
  };

  const updateConsent = (checked: boolean) => {
    onChange((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      consentementDonneesSante: {
        accepteCollecteEtTransmission: checked,
        dateConsentement: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div id="section-autorisation-signature" className="space-y-8">
      {/* 5. Autorisation parentale & Prise en charge d'urgence */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xs space-y-6">
        <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-blue-950">
            <FileCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-900" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
              5. Autorisation parentale de prise en charge
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Reprise intégrale du texte officiel d'autorisation de l'établissement ({nomEtab}).
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Déclarant */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Je, soussigné(e) (Nom et Prénom) <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.autorisationParentale.soussigneNomPrenom || data.responsableLegal.nom}
              onChange={(e) => updateAuth('soussigneNomPrenom', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: DUPONT Marc"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.soussigne ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.soussigne && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.soussigne}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Qualité du soussigné <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
              {[
                { id: 'pere', label: 'Père' },
                { id: 'mere', label: 'Mère' },
                { id: 'autres', label: 'Autre' },
              ].map((q) => (
                <button
                  key={q.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => updateAuth('qualite', q.id)}
                  className={`py-2 px-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border text-center transition-all ${
                    data.autorisationParentale.qualite === q.id
                      ? 'bg-blue-900 text-white border-blue-950 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-white text-slate-700 border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50'
                  }`}
                >
                  {q.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Agissant en qualité de rep. légal de <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              readOnly
              value={`${data.eleve.prenom} ${data.eleve.nom}`.trim() || "L'élève"}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl font-medium focus:outline-none cursor-not-allowed"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {data.autorisationParentale.qualite === 'autres' && (
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Précision sur la qualité (Tuteur, Mandataire, etc.) <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.autorisationParentale.autreQualitePrecision || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateAuth('autreQualitePrecision', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: Tuteur légal désigné par décision de justice"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Legal Authorizations box */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-blue-50/50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl space-y-4 text-xs text-slate-800 leading-relaxed">
          <p className="font-bold text-blue-950 text-sm">AUTORISE EXPRESSÉMENT :</p>

          <div className="space-y-3 pl-1">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-900 mt-2 shrink-0"></span>
              <p>
                <strong>{nomEtab}</strong> à prendre, le cas échéant, toutes mesures (visite médicale, hospitalisation, transport en voiture, intervention des secours – pompiers ou SAMU) rendues nécessaires par l'état de santé de mon enfant.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-900 mt-2 shrink-0"></span>
              <p>
                <strong>Le praticien</strong> à pratiquer tout examen médical ou chirurgical nécessaire à l'établissement d'un diagnostic, et toute intervention médicale ou chirurgicale y compris avec phase d'anesthésie-réanimation que nécessiterait l'état de santé de mon enfant.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-blue-200/70 space-y-2">
            <label className="flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer bg-white p-3 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 shadow-2xs">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={data.autorisationParentale.accordPriseEnCharge}
                onChange={(e) => updateAuth('accordPriseEnCharge', e.target.checked)}
                className="mt-0.5 rounded text-blue-900 focus:ring-blue-900 w-4 h-4"
              />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                Je valide expressément l'autorisation de prise en charge d'urgence et d'interventions médicales pour mon enfant. <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
              </span>
            </label>
            {errors.accordPriseEnCharge && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 font-semibold">{errors.accordPriseEnCharge}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Fait à et le */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Fait à <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.autorisationParentale.faitA}
              onChange={(e) => updateAuth('faitA', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: Charenton-le-Pont"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.faitA ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.faitA && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.faitA}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Date du jour <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.autorisationParentale.faitLe || new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}
              onChange={(e) => updateAuth('faitLe', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="JJ/MM/AAAA"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Signature Pad */}
        <div className="pt-2">
          <SignaturePad
            value={data.autorisationParentale.signatureDataUrl}
            signerName={data.autorisationParentale.soussigneNomPrenom || data.responsableLegal.nom}
            onChange={(dataUrl) => {
              updateAuth('signatureDataUrl', dataUrl);
              updateAuth('dateHeureSignature', new Date().toISOString());
              updateAuth('signataireNomComplet', data.autorisationParentale.soussigneNomPrenom || data.responsableLegal.nom);
              updateAuth('mentionLuEtApprouve', true);
            }}
          />
          {errors.signature && (
            <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 font-semibold mt-1.5">{errors.signature}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 6. Informations relatives aux données de santé & Consentement RGPD */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-blue-950 pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
          <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-900" />
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
            6. Informations relatives aux données de santé & Consentement (RGPD)
          </h2>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
          <p>
            Les données de santé figurant sur le présent document sont recueillies par l'établissement afin, notamment, de répondre aux demandes des services médicaux d'urgence.
          </p>
          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800">Elles sont susceptibles d'être transmises :</p>
          <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1">
            <li>aux services médicaux d'urgence,</li>
            <li>en tant que de besoin aux membres de l'équipe éducative de l'établissement directement concernés,</li>
            <li>et, dans le cadre des projets d'accompagnement spécifique (PAI, PPS,...) : aux partenaires mentionnés dans ces projets (MDPH, Praticiens médicaux et para-médicaux,...).</li>
          </ul>
          <p>
            Vous consentez expressément à ce que l'établissement traite ces informations dans le cadre de la scolarisation de l'élève au sein de l'établissement dans les modalités définies au PAI ou au titre du PPS dont il bénéficie. Pour ces données vous disposez du droit de retirer votre consentement à leur collecte et à leur traitement.
          </p>
        </div>

        <label className="flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer p-3.5 bg-emerald-50/50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-emerald-50 transition-colors">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={data.consentementDonneesSante.accepteCollecteEtTransmission}
            onChange={(e) => updateConsent(e.target.checked)}
            className="mt-0.5 rounded text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-600 w-4 h-4"
          />
          <div className="text-xs">
            <span className="font-bold text-emerald-950 block">
              Consentement exprès pour le traitement des données de santé <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-600">
              Je consens expressément à la collecte, au traitement et à la transmission éventuelle de ces données médicales dans le respect strict des finalités d'urgence et de scolarisation mentionnées ci-dessus.
            </span>
          </div>
        </label>
        {errors.consentement && (
          <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 font-semibold">{errors.consentement}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Buttons */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onPrev}
          className="px-5 py-2.5 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
        >
          ← Retour à l'Urgence & Santé
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onNext}
          className="px-6 py-3 bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-sm shadow-xs hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          Vérifier et relire avant transmission →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/ChangeStaffPasswordModal.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/ChangeStaffPasswordModal.tsx -->
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { KeyRound, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, X, Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { StaffProfile } from '../types';

interface ChangeStaffPasswordModalProps {
  currentStaff: StaffProfile | { username: string; label?: string };
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess?: (message: string) => void;
}

export function ChangeStaffPasswordModal({
  currentStaff,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: ChangeStaffPasswordModalProps) {
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showCurrent, setShowCurrent] = useState(false);
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!currentPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Veuillez renseigner votre mot de passe actuel.');
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 8) {
      setErrorMessage('Le nouveau mot de passe doit comporter au moins 8 caractères.');
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Les deux nouveaux mots de passe ne correspondent pas.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/admin/change-password', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          username: currentStaff.username,
          currentPassword,
          newPassword,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Erreur lors du changement de mot de passe.');
      }

      setSuccessMessage(data.message || 'Mot de passe modifié avec succès.');
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess(data.message);
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Erreur de communication avec le serveur.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const accountDisplayName =
    currentStaff.label ||
    (currentStaff.username === 'infirmerie' ? 'Service Infirmerie' : 'Direction / Administrateur');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-950 to-slate-900 text-white p-5 px-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-800/60 border border-blue-600/50 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-200">
              <KeyRound className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-white">Changer le mot de passe</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-blue-200">
                Session : <span className="font-semibold text-white">{accountDisplayName}</span> ({currentStaff.username})
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-blue-200 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* Info pill */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/70 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-blue-950 flex items-start gap-2">
            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span>
              La modification est immédiate et chiffrée en <strong>PBKDF2-SHA512</strong> dans le coffre-fort local du serveur.
            </span>
          </div>

          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {successMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{successMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold mb-1">
                Mot de passe actuel
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showCurrent ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={currentPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setCurrentPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Saisissez votre mot de passe actuel"
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 text-slate-900"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCurrent(!showCurrent)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {showCurrent ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold mb-1">
                Nouveau mot de passe (8 caractères minimum)
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showNew ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={newPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Au moins 8 caractères"
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 text-slate-900"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowNew(!showNew)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {showNew ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-700 font-semibold mb-1">
                Confirmer le nouveau mot de passe
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showConfirm ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={confirmPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Répétez le nouveau mot de passe"
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 text-slate-900"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowConfirm(!showConfirm)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {showConfirm ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={loading}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading || !currentPassword || !newPassword || !confirmPassword}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <span>Enregistrement...</span>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Mettre à jour mon mot de passe</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/ClassManagementModal.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/ClassManagementModal.tsx -->
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Plus, Edit2, Trash2, Check, AlertCircle, Users } from 'lucide-react';

interface ClassManagementModalProps {
  classes: string[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onClassCreated: (newClass: string) => Promise<void>;
  onClassRenamed: (oldName: string, newName: string) => Promise<void>;
  onClassDeleted: (name: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export function ClassManagementModal({
  classes,
  onClose,
  onClassCreated,
  onClassRenamed,
  onClassDeleted,
}: ClassManagementModalProps) {
  const [newClassName, setNewClassName] = useState('');
  const [editingOldName, setEditingOldName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingNewName, setEditingNewName] = useState('');
  const [deletingName, setDeletingName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCreate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newClassName.trim()) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    try {
      await onClassCreated(newClassName.trim());
      setSuccessMessage(`Classe "${newClassName.trim()}" créée avec succès.`);
      setNewClassName('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Erreur lors de la création de la classe.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (className: string) => {
    setEditingOldName(className);
    setEditingNewName(className);
    setDeletingName(null);
    setErrorMessage(null);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = async (oldName: string) => {
    if (!editingNewName.trim() || editingNewName.trim() === oldName) {
      setEditingOldName(null);
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    try {
      await onClassRenamed(oldName, editingNewName.trim());
      setSuccessMessage(`Classe "${oldName}" renommée en "${editingNewName.trim()}".`);
      setEditingOldName(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Erreur lors de la modification de la classe.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const confirmDelete = async (name: string) => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    try {
      await onClassDeleted(name);
      setSuccessMessage(`Classe "${name}" supprimée.`);
      setDeletingName(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Erreur lors de la suppression de la classe.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-blue-950 text-white p-4 px-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-300" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base">Gestion des Classes</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-blue-200">Créer, modifier ou supprimer les classes scolaires</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-blue-200 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-5">
          {/* Notifications */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-rose-700 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {successMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-emerald-800 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{successMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Form to create a new class */}
          <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide">
              Ajouter une nouvelle classe
            </label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={newClassName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewClassName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex: 6ème E, 2nde 5, BTS 1..."
                className="flex-1 px-3.5 py-2 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting || !newClassName.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Ajouter</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* List of current classes */}
          <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 font-semibold">
              <span>Classes existantes ({classes.length})</span>
              <span>Actions</span>
            </div>

            <div className="max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1">
              {classes.map((className) => {
                const isEditing = editingOldName === className;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={className}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 transition-colors"
                  >
                    {isEditing ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 mr-2">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={editingNewName}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditingNewName(e.target.value)}
                          className="flex-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-sm bg-white border border-blue-900 rounded-lg focus:outline-none"
                          autoFocus
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSaveEdit(className);
                            if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditingOldName(null);
                          }}
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(className)}
                          disabled={isSubmitting}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                          title="Valider la modification"
                        >
                          <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setEditingOldName(null)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 cursor-pointer"
                          title="Annuler"
                        >
                          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ) : deletingName === className ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 p-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs">
                        <span className="text-rose-900 font-semibold">Supprimer cette classe ?</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => confirmDelete(className)}
                          disabled={isSubmitting}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-bold rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Oui, supprimer
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setDeletingName(null)}
                          disabled={isSubmitting}
                          className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 text-slate-700 font-semibold rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Annuler
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{className}</span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleStartEdit(className)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-900 hover:bg-white rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            title="Modifier le nom de la classe"
                          >
                            <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setDeletingName(className);
                              setEditingOldName(null);
                            }}
                            className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-white rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            title="Supprimer la classe"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 px-6 py-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 text-slate-700 font-semibold rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Fermer
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { FicheInfirmerieData } from '../types';
import { getFicheFileName, getCarnetFileName, formatClassDirectory } from '../utils/pdfGenerator';
import { CheckCircle2, Download, Cloud, Mail, FileText, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSchoolName } from '../utils/branding';

interface ConfirmationSuccessProps {
  data: FicheInfirmerieData;
  fichePdfBlob?: Blob | null;
  carnetPdfBlob?: Blob | null;
  onReset: () => void;
  onGoToAdmin: () => void;
}

export function ConfirmationSuccess({
  data,
  fichePdfBlob,
  carnetPdfBlob,
  onReset,
  onGoToAdmin,
}: ConfirmationSuccessProps) {
  const nomEtab = useSchoolName();
  useEffect(() => {
    // Launch celebratory confetti
    confetti({
      particleCount: 80,
      spread: 70,
      origin: { y: 0.6 },
    });
  }, []);

  const downloadFiche = () => {
    if (!fichePdfBlob) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(fichePdfBlob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = getFicheFileName(data);
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const downloadCarnet = () => {
    if (!carnetPdfBlob) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(carnetPdfBlob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = getCarnetFileName(data);
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const classFolder = formatClassDirectory(data.eleve.classe);
  const nextcloudTreePath = `FICHES INFIRMERIE / ${data.schoolYear} / ${classFolder} / ${getFicheFileName(data)}`;
  const nextcloudCarnetPath = `FICHES INFIRMERIE / ${data.schoolYear} / ${classFolder} / ${getCarnetFileName(data)}`;

  return (
    <div id="confirmation-succes" className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Top Card */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-emerald-200 p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-sm text-center relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 shadow-xs">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-9 h-9" />
        </div>

        <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 inline-block mb-2">
          Fiche infirmerie validée & verrouillée
        </span>

        <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
          Félicitations, la fiche de {data.eleve.prenom} {data.eleve.nom} a été enregistrée !
        </h2>

        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 max-w-xl mx-auto mt-2 leading-relaxed">
          Le document officiel A4 a été généré avec la signature électronique du représentant légal et archivé de manière sécurisée dans le dossier d'infirmerie de l'établissement.
        </p>

        {/* Automatic filing callout */}
        <div className="mt-6 p-4 sm:p-5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl text-left space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-blue-950 uppercase tracking-wide">
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-900" />
            Classement automatique du dossier d'infirmerie
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 p-3.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs space-y-1.5 shadow-inner">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span>
              <span>Dossier : FICHES INFIRMERIE/{data.schoolYear}/{classFolder}/</span>
            </div>
            <div className="pl-4 text-slate-300">
              ├── 📄 {getFicheFileName(data)}
            </div>
            <div className="pl-4 text-slate-300">
              └── 📎 {getCarnetFileName(data)}
            </div>
          </div>

          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
            ✓ Conformité au cahier des charges : classement par année scolaire ({data.schoolYear}), par classe ({classFolder}), puis par ordre alphabétique de nom d'élève.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Download Buttons */}
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={downloadFiche}
            className="px-5 py-3 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Télécharger la Fiche Infirmerie (PDF A4)
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={downloadCarnet}
            className="px-5 py-3 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
            Télécharger le Carnet de Vaccinations (PDF)
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Confirmation Email Preview (§21) */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xs space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide">
            <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-900" />
            Accusé de réception officiel adressé à la famille (§21)
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold">
            Généré automatiquement
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-700 space-y-2 font-sans">
          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
            Objet : Confirmation – Fiche infirmerie de {data.eleve.nom.toUpperCase()} {data.eleve.prenom} ({data.eleve.classe})
          </p>
          <p>Bonjour,</p>
          <p>
            Nous vous confirmons la réception de la fiche infirmerie de votre enfant <strong>{data.eleve.prenom} {data.eleve.nom.toUpperCase()}</strong>.
          </p>
          <p>
            La fiche signée ainsi que la copie du carnet de vaccinations ont bien été enregistrées et transmises à l'infirmerie.
          </p>
          <p className="pt-2 text-slate-500">
            Cordialement,<br />
            <strong>{nomEtab}</strong>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Navigation */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 pt-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onReset}
          className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Renseigner la fiche d'un autre élève
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onGoToAdmin}
          className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <span>Accéder au tableau de bord Infirmerie</span>
          <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/EditStudentClassModal.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/EditStudentClassModal.tsx -->
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FicheInfirmerieData } from '../types';
import { X, Check, School, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface EditStudentClassModalProps {
  fiche: FicheInfirmerieData;
  classes: string[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onClassUpdated: (ficheId: string, newClass: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export function EditStudentClassModal({
  fiche,
  classes,
  onClose,
  onClassUpdated,
}: EditStudentClassModalProps) {
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState(fiche.eleve?.classe || '');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!fiche.id || !selectedClass.trim()) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onClassUpdated(fiche.id, selectedClass.trim());
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Erreur lors du changement de classe.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
        <div className="bg-blue-950 text-white p-4 px-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <School className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-300" />
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm">Modifier la classe de l'élève</h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-blue-200 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">Élève concerné :</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
              {fiche.eleve?.nom?.toUpperCase()} {fiche.eleve?.prenom}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-blue-900 mt-0.5">
              Classe actuelle : <strong>{fiche.eleve?.classe || 'Non assignée'}</strong>
            </p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-rose-700 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 uppercase">
              Sélectionner la nouvelle classe :
            </label>
            <select
              value={selectedClass}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedClass(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none"
              required
            >
              <option value="">-- Choisir une classe --</option>
              {classes.map((cl) => (
                <option key={cl} value={cl}>
                  {cl}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
            >
              Annuler
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || !selectedClass.trim() || selectedClass === fiche.eleve?.classe}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Enregistrer la nouvelle classe</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useSchoolName } from '../utils/branding';
import { FicheInfirmerieData } from '../types';
import { generateFichePDF, getFicheFileName, generateCarnetPDF, getCarnetFileName } from '../utils/pdfGenerator';
import {
  FileText,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
  Printer,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  User,
  Shield,
  Heart,
  FileCheck,
  Calendar,
  Phone,
  MapPin,
  Stethoscope,
  Eye,
  File
} from 'lucide-react';

interface FicheDocumentPreviewProps {
  fiche: FicheInfirmerieData;
  initialTab?: 'fiche' | 'carnet';
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function FicheDocumentPreview({
  fiche,
  initialTab = 'fiche',
  onClose,
}: FicheDocumentPreviewProps) {
  const nomEtab = useSchoolName();
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'fiche' | 'carnet' | 'pdf_raw'>(initialTab);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [pdfBlobUrl, setPdfBlobUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasCarnet = (fiche.sante.carnetVaccinations || []).length > 0;
  const isSigned = !!fiche.autorisationParentale?.signatureDataUrl;

  // Direct download PDF
  const handleDownloadFiche = async () => {
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const blob = await generateFichePDF(fiche);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = getFicheFileName(fiche);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erreur téléchargement PDF:', err);
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  // Direct download Carnet PDF
  const handleDownloadCarnet = async () => {
    if (!hasCarnet) return;
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const blob = await generateCarnetPDF(fiche);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = getCarnetFileName(fiche);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erreur téléchargement Carnet:', err);
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  // Open in new tab
  const handleOpenNewTab = async () => {
    try {
      const blob = await generateFichePDF(fiche);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      window.open(url, '_blank');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erreur ouverture nouvel onglet:', err);
    }
  };

  // Print
  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl max-w-5xl w-full max-h-[96vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-slate-300 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="bg-blue-950 text-white p-4 sm:px-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-blue-900 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-900 border border-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <FileCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-200" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight">
                  {fiche.eleve.nom.toUpperCase()} {fiche.eleve.prenom}
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-800 text-blue-100 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md border border-blue-700">
                  Classe : {fiche.eleve.classe}
                </span>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md border border-emerald-700">
                  {fiche.schoolYear}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-blue-300 mt-0.5">
                Aperçu officiel de la Fiche Infirmerie Scolaire
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDownloadFiche}
              disabled={downloading}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Télécharger le PDF A4"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Télécharger PDF</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleOpenNewTab}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-900/80 hover:bg-blue-800 text-blue-200 hover:text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Ouvrir le PDF plein écran dans un nouvel onglet"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Nouvel onglet</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-900/80 hover:bg-blue-800 text-blue-200 hover:text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Imprimer"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Imprimer</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-blue-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-blue-900 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ml-1"
              title="Fermer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* View Tabs */}
        <div className="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveView('fiche')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeView === 'fiche'
                ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Fiche Infirmerie Officielle</span>
          </button>

          {hasCarnet && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveView('carnet')}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                activeView === 'carnet'
                  ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
              }`}
            >
              <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              <span>Carnet de vaccinations ({fiche.sante.carnetVaccinations?.length})</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 bg-slate-200/70 flex justify-center">
          {activeView === 'fiche' && (
            /* OFFICIAL A4 DOCUMENT REPLICA - Pixel-perfect, zero error rate */
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-slate-300 p-6 sm:p-8 w-full max-w-[850px] text-slate-800 space-y-4 text-xs font-sans">
              {/* Header Institutionnel */}
              <div className="border-b-2 border-blue-950 pb-4 space-y-2">

                    src="/logo.svg"
                    alt={`Logo ${nomEtab}`}
                    className="w-14 h-16 object-contain shrink-0"

                  <div className="text-left space-y-0.5">
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-blue-950 uppercase tracking-wide">
                      {nomEtab}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Établissement Catholique d'Enseignement • Sous-contrat d'Association avec l'État • Service Infirmerie
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="text-center pt-1">
                  <div className="py-1.5 px-6 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg inline-block shadow-2xs">
                    <h4 className="text-base font-extrabold text-blue-950 tracking-wider uppercase">
                      FICHE INFIRMERIE
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 font-medium">

              {/* 1. IDENTITÉ DE L'ÉLÈVE */}
              <div className="border border-blue-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
```
