```tsx
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Official Document Preview Frame */}
            <div className="border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-6 bg-slate-50 space-y-4 shadow-inner max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-4 rounded-lg">
                <p className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                  RÉPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE • ENSEIGNEMENT CATHOLIQUE SOUS CONTRAT D'ASSOCIATION
                </p>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-black mt-1">
                  ATTESTATION OFFICIELLE DE CONFORMITÉ RGPD & SANTÉ SCOLAIRE
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 mt-0.5">
                  Règlement (UE) 2016/679 • Réf : {config.reference} • Année : {config.schoolYear}
                </p>

              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 p-3.5 rounded-lg space-y-1">

              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 p-3.5 rounded-lg space-y-1.5">

                </p>
                <ul className="list-disc pl-4 space-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/SchoolBrandingModal.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/SchoolBrandingModal.tsx -->
```tsx
import { getSchoolName } from '../utils/branding';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SchoolBranding } from '../types';
import { School, Upload, RotateCcw, Save, X, Check, Image as ImageIcon, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface SchoolBrandingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  branding?: SchoolBranding;
  onSaved: (newBranding: SchoolBranding) => void;
}

export function SchoolBrandingModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  branding,
  onSaved,
}: SchoolBrandingModalProps) {
  const [schoolName, setSchoolName] = useState(branding?.schoolName || getSchoolName());
  const [subTitle, setSubTitle] = useState(branding?.subTitle || "Sous-contrat d'Association avec l'État");
  const [logoDataUrl, setLogoDataUrl] = useState<string>(branding?.logoDataUrl || '');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!file.type.match(/^image\/(png|jpeg|webp|svg\+xml)$/)) {
      setError('Format non supporté. Veuillez sélectionner une image PNG, JPG, WebP ou SVG.');
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError('L’image est trop volumineuse (maximum 2 Mo conseillé).');
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      if (typeof event.target?.result === 'string') {
        setLogoDataUrl(event.target.result);
        setError(null);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!schoolName.trim()) {
      setError("Le nom de l'établissement est requis.");
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/branding', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          schoolName: schoolName.trim(),
          subTitle: subTitle.trim(),
          logoDataUrl,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Erreur lors de la sauvegarde');
      }

      onSaved(data.branding);
      setSuccessMsg('Identité et logo sauvegardés avec succès !');
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 900);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Impossible de sauvegarder les modifications.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Rétablir le nom d'établissement et le logo d'origine ?")) return;

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/branding/reset', { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setSchoolName(data.branding.schoolName);
        setSubTitle(data.branding.subTitle);
        setLogoDataUrl('');
        onSaved(data.branding);
        setSuccessMsg('Paramètres par défaut rétablis.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Erreur lors de la réinitialisation.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-2xl max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
              <School className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm tracking-wide">Identité & Logo de l'Établissement</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Personnalisez le nom affiché et le logo officiel</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-6 space-y-4">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-rose-700 flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {successMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{successMsg}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* School Name */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
              Nom officiel de l'Établissement <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={schoolName}
              onChange={(e) => setSchoolName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nom officiel de l'établissement"
              className="w-full text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent transition-all"
              required
            />
          </div>

          {/* Subtitle / mention */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
              Sous-titre / Statut juridique
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={subTitle}
              onChange={(e) => setSubTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: Sous-contrat d'Association avec l'État"
              className="w-full text-xs px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent transition-all"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Logo upload & preview */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Logo de l'Établissement (PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG)
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg bg-white border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center p-1 overflow-hidden shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                {logoDataUrl ? (
                  <img
                    src={logoDataUrl}
                    alt="Logo personnalisé"
                    className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <img
                    src="/logo.svg"
                    alt="Logo par défaut"
                    className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                  />
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
                <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-2xs">
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-700" />
                  <span>Choisir une image</span>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/svg+xml"
                    onChange={handleFileChange}
                    className="hidden"
                  />
                </label>
                {logoDataUrl && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setLogoDataUrl('')}
                    className="ml-2 text-xs text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 font-semibold cursor-pointer underline"
                  >
                    Effacer le logo personnalisé
                  </button>
                )}
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  Visible en en-tête et sur tous les documents officiels. Max 2 Mo.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleReset}
              disabled={isSaving}
              className="px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Rétablir défaut</span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isSaving ? 'Enregistrement...' : 'Enregistrer'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/SignaturePad.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/SignaturePad.tsx -->
```tsx
import { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { RotateCcw, Trash2, Check, PenTool } from 'lucide-react';

interface SignaturePadProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (dataUrl: string) => void;
  signerName: string;
}

export function SignaturePad({ value, onChange, signerName }: SignaturePadProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const [isDrawing, setIsDrawing] = useState(false);
  const [hasDrawn, setHasDrawn] = useState(!!value);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'draw' | 'type'>(value ? 'draw' : 'draw');
  const [typedName, setTypedName] = useState(signerName || '');

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    // Set high DPI canvas resolution
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
    canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#14274E';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    if (value && value.startsWith('data:image')) {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
        setHasDrawn(true);
      };
      img.src = value;
    }
  }, []);

  const getCoordinates = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if ('touches' in e && e.touches.length > 0) {
      return {
        x: e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left,
        y: e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top,
      };
    } else if ('clientX' in e) {
      return {
        x: (e as React.MouseEvent).clientX - rect.left,
        y: (e as React.MouseEvent).clientY - rect.top,
      };
    }
    return { x: 0, y: 0 };
  };

  const startDrawing = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const coords = getCoordinates(e);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(coords.x, coords.y);
    setIsDrawing(true);
  };

  const draw = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!isDrawing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const coords = getCoordinates(e);
    ctx.lineTo(coords.x, coords.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    setHasDrawn(true);
  };

  const stopDrawing = () => {
    if (!isDrawing) return;
    setIsDrawing(false);
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (canvas) {
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      onChange(dataUrl);
    }
  };

  const clear = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
    setHasDrawn(false);
    onChange('');
  };

  const applyTypedSignature = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !typedName.trim()) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
    ctx.font = 'italic 28px "Playfair Display", "Times New Roman", cursive';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#14274E';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(typedName, rect.width / 2, rect.height / 2);

    setHasDrawn(true);
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    onChange(dataUrl);
  };

  return (
    <div id="signature-pad-container" className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
          <PenTool className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-900" />
          Signature électronique du représentant légal <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
        </label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMode('draw')}
            className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors ${
              mode === 'draw'
                ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white'
                : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            Tracé manuscrit
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMode('type')}
            className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors ${
              mode === 'type'
                ? 'bg-blue-950 text-white'
                : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            Saisie clavier
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {mode === 'type' && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg space-y-2">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
            Saisissez votre nom et prénom légal pour apposer une signature certifiée :
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={typedName}
              onChange={(e) => setTypedName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: Jean DUPONT"
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={applyTypedSignature}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Appliquer
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="relative border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-xs hover:border-slate-400 transition-colors">
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          onMouseDown={startDrawing}
          onMouseMove={draw}
          onMouseUp={stopDrawing}
          onMouseLeave={stopDrawing}
          onTouchStart={startDrawing}
          onTouchMove={draw}
          onTouchEnd={stopDrawing}
          className="w-full h-36 cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        />

        {!hasDrawn && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 select-none">
            <PenTool className="w-6 h-6 mb-1 text-slate-300" />
            <span className="text-xs font-medium">Signez ici avec votre souris, votre doigt ou un stylet</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-1 pointer-events-none">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-serif italic font-bold text-blue-950">
            « Lu et approuvé »
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
            Horodatage & intégrité numérique garantis
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {hasDrawn ? (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 font-medium bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200">
              <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> Signature enregistrée
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-amber-700 font-medium bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-200">
              Signature obligatoire requise
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={clear}
          disabled={!hasDrawn}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-600 hover:text-rose-600 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors"
        >
          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Effacer
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/StudentFormSection.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { SchoolClass, SCHOOL_CLASSES, FicheInfirmerieData } from '../types';
import { User, MapPin, Phone, Stethoscope, Users, Building2, Plus, Check } from 'lucide-react';

interface StudentFormSectionProps {
  data: FicheInfirmerieData;
  onChange: (updater: (prev: FicheInfirmerieData) => FicheInfirmerieData) => void;
  onNext: () => void;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
}

export function StudentFormSection({ data, onChange, onNext, errors }: StudentFormSectionProps) {
  const [classesList, setClassesList] = useState<string[]>(SCHOOL_CLASSES);
  const [isAddingNewClass, setIsAddingNewClass] = useState(false);
  const [newClassName, setNewClassName] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/classes')
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((json) => {
        if (json.success && Array.isArray(json.classes) && json.classes.length > 0) {
          setClassesList(json.classes);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const handleAddNewClass = async () => {
    if (!newClassName.trim()) return;
    const trimmed = newClassName.trim();
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/classes', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: trimmed }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        setClassesList(json.classes);
      } else {
        if (!classesList.includes(trimmed)) {
          setClassesList((prev) => [...prev, trimmed]);
        }
      }
      updateEleve('classe', trimmed);
      setIsAddingNewClass(false);
      setNewClassName('');
    } catch {
      if (!classesList.includes(trimmed)) {
        setClassesList((prev) => [...prev, trimmed]);
      }
      updateEleve('classe', trimmed);
      setIsAddingNewClass(false);
      setNewClassName('');
    }
  };
  const updateEleve = (field: keyof FicheInfirmerieData['eleve'], value: string) => {
    onChange((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      eleve: { ...prev.eleve, [field]: value },
    }));
  };

  const updateResp = (field: keyof FicheInfirmerieData['responsableLegal'], value: any) => {
    onChange((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      responsableLegal: { ...prev.responsableLegal, [field]: value },
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div id="section-eleve-responsables" className="space-y-8">
      {/* 1. Identité de l'élève */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xs space-y-6">
        <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-blue-950">
            <User className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-900" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
              1. Identité de l'élève
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tous les renseignements de la fiche papier sont obligatoires pour la sécurité médicale de l'enfant.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* Classe */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Classe de l'élève <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
              </label>
              {!isAddingNewClass ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddingNewClass(true)}
                  className="text-[11px] text-blue-900 font-bold hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3 h-3" /> Autre classe
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddingNewClass(false)}
                  className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 hover:underline"
                >
                  Choisir dans la liste
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {isAddingNewClass ? (
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newClassName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewClassName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex: 6ème E, ULIS..."
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border border-blue-900 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none"
                  autoFocus
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      handleAddNewClass();
                    }
                  }}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddNewClass}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors"
                >
                  OK
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                value={data.eleve.classe}
                onChange={(e) => updateEleve('classe', e.target.value as SchoolClass)}
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none transition-colors ${
                  errors.classe ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              >
                <option value="">-- Sélectionner la classe --</option>
                {classesList.map((cl) => (
                  <option key={cl} value={cl}>
                    {cl}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
            {errors.classe && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.classe}</p>}
          </div>

          {/* Nom */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Nom de famille <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.eleve.nom}
              onChange={(e) => updateEleve('nom', e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
              placeholder="Ex: DUPONT"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none uppercase ${
                errors.nom ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.nom && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.nom}</p>}
          </div>

          {/* Prénom */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Prénom <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.eleve.prenom}
              onChange={(e) => updateEleve('prenom', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: Jean"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.prenom ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.prenom && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.prenom}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* Date de naissance */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Date de naissance <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={data.eleve.dateNaissance}
              onChange={(e) => updateEleve('dateNaissance', e.target.value)}
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.dateNaissance ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.dateNaissance && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.dateNaissance}</p>}
          </div>

          {/* Adresse */}
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Adresse de l'élève <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={data.eleve.adresse}
                onChange={(e) => updateEleve('adresse', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Numéro et nom de voie"
                className={`w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                  errors.adresse ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              />
              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>
            {errors.adresse && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.adresse}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* CP */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Code Postal (CP) <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={5}
              value={data.eleve.codePostal}
              onChange={(e) => updateEleve('codePostal', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: 94220"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.codePostal ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.codePostal && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.codePostal}</p>}
          </div>

          {/* Ville */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Ville <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.eleve.ville}
              onChange={(e) => updateEleve('ville', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: Charenton-le-Pont"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.ville ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.ville && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.ville}</p>}
          </div>

          {/* Médecin traitant (Nom) */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Nom du médecin traitant <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={data.eleve.nomMedecinTraitant}
                onChange={(e) => updateEleve('nomMedecinTraitant', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex: Dr. Garnier"
                className={`w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                  errors.nomMedecinTraitant ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              />
              <Stethoscope className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>
            {errors.nomMedecinTraitant && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.nomMedecinTraitant}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Téléphone médecin traitant */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              N° Téléphone du médecin traitant <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type="tel"
                value={data.eleve.telMedecinTraitant}
                onChange={(e) => updateEleve('telMedecinTraitant', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex: 01 43 76 89 20"
                className={`w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                  errors.telMedecinTraitant ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              />
              <Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>
            {errors.telMedecinTraitant && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.telMedecinTraitant}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Personnes responsables de l'élève */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xs space-y-6">
        <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-blue-950">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-900" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
              2. Personnes responsables de l'élève
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Indiquez le responsable légal et les coordonnées professionnelles des parents.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* Nom du responsable légal */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Nom du responsable légal <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={data.responsableLegal.nom}
              onChange={(e) => updateResp('nom', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ex: DUPONT Marc"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                errors.nomResponsable ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
              }`}
            />
            {errors.nomResponsable && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.nomResponsable}</p>}
          </div>

          {/* Statut du responsable légal */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Qualité du responsable <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {[
                { id: 'pere', label: 'Père' },
                { id: 'mere', label: 'Mère' },
                { id: 'responsable_tuteur', label: 'Tuteur' },
              ].map((opt) => (
                <label
                  key={opt.id}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-center py-2 px-2 border rounded-xl text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                    data.responsableLegal.statut === opt.id
                      ? 'border-blue-900 bg-blue-900 text-white shadow-2xs font-semibold'
                      : 'border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="statutResponsable"
                    value={opt.id}
                    checked={data.responsableLegal.statut === opt.id}
                    onChange={() => updateResp('statut', opt.id)}
                    className="sr-only"
                  />
                  <span>{opt.label}</span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Téléphone personnel du responsable */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Tél. personnel du responsable <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type="tel"
                value={data.responsableLegal.telPersonnel}
                onChange={(e) => updateResp('telPersonnel', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex: 06 12 34 56 78"
                className={`w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none ${
                  errors.telPersonnelResponsable ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              />
              <Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>
            {errors.telPersonnelResponsable && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 mt-1">{errors.telPersonnelResponsable}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Coordonnées professionnelles */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
            Coordonnées professionnelles des parents
          </h3>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
            {/* Tél. travail mère */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Téléphone professionnel de la mère <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                disabled={data.responsableLegal.telTravailMereNonConcerne}
                value={data.responsableLegal.telTravailMereNonConcerne ? 'Non concerné' : data.responsableLegal.telTravailMere}
                onChange={(e) => updateResp('telTravailMere', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex: 01 45 23 89 00"
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-400 ${
                  errors.telTravailMere ? 'border-rose-500' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              />
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={data.responsableLegal.telTravailMereNonConcerne}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const checked = e.target.checked;
                    updateResp('telTravailMereNonConcerne', checked);
                    if (checked) {
                      updateResp('telTravailMere', 'Non concerné');
                    } else {
                      updateResp('telTravailMere', '');
                    }
                  }}
                  className="rounded text-blue-900 focus:ring-blue-900"
                />
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
                  Non concerné (retraite, sans emploi, ou non applicable)
                </span>
              </label>
              {errors.telTravailMere && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600">{errors.telTravailMere}</p>}
            </div>

            {/* Tél. travail père */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Téléphone professionnel du père <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                disabled={data.responsableLegal.telTravailPereNonConcerne}
                value={data.responsableLegal.telTravailPereNonConcerne ? 'Non concerné' : data.responsableLegal.telTravailPere}
                onChange={(e) => updateResp('telTravailPere', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex: 01 42 30 11 22"
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:outline-none disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-400 ${
                  errors.telTravailPere ? 'border-rose-500' : 'border-slate-300'
                }`}
              />
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={data.responsableLegal.telTravailPereNonConcerne}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const checked = e.target.checked;
                    updateResp('telTravailPereNonConcerne', checked);
                    if (checked) {
                      updateResp('telTravailPere', 'Non concerné');
                    } else {
                      updateResp('telTravailPere', '');
                    }
                  }}
                  className="rounded text-blue-900 focus:ring-blue-900"
                />
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
                  Non concerné (retraite, sans emploi, ou non applicable)
                </span>
              </label>
              {errors.telTravailPere && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600">{errors.telTravailPere}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Button to Next Step */}
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onNext}
          className="px-6 py-3 bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-sm shadow-xs hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          Continuer vers l'Urgence & la Santé →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/components/VaccinationUpload.tsx`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/components/VaccinationUpload.tsx -->
```tsx
import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Upload, FileText, Image as ImageIcon, Trash2, Eye, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { UploadedFile } from '../types';

interface VaccinationUploadProps {
  files: UploadedFile[];
  onChange: (files: UploadedFile[]) => void;
}

export function VaccinationUpload({ files, onChange }: VaccinationUploadProps) {
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);
  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState<UploadedFile | null>(null);

  const processFiles = (fileList: FileList | null) => {
    if (!fileList || fileList.length === 0) return;

    const newUploadedFiles: UploadedFile[] = [];

    Array.from(fileList).forEach((file) => {
      // Accept PDF, PNG, JPEG, JPG
      if (!file.type.match(/(pdf|image\/(jpeg|png|jpg|webp))/i)) {
        alert(`Format non supporté pour ${file.name}. Formats acceptés : PDF, JPG, PNG.`);
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        const dataUrl = reader.result as string;
        const uploaded: UploadedFile = {
          id: `doc-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6)}`,
          name: file.name,
          type: file.type,
          size: file.size,
          dataUrl,
          uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        onChange([...files, uploaded]);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOver(false);
    processFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
  };

  const removeFile = (id: string) => {
    onChange(files.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
  };

  // Sample carnet generator for instant 1-click testing
  const addSampleCarnet = () => {
    // Generate a clean sample carnet image canvas
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 600;
    canvas.height = 800;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 600, 800);

      // Header
      ctx.fillStyle = '#14274E';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('RÉPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE', 170, 70);
      ctx.font = 'bold 26px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('CARNET DE SANTÉ / VACCINATIONS', 80, 115);

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#14274E';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeRect(40, 140, 520, 600);

      // Lines & stamps
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2B3A42';
      ctx.font = '16px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Vaccinations obligatoires :', 60, 190);
      ctx.fillText('• Diphtérie - Tétanos - Poliomyélite (DTP) : À JOUR', 60, 240);
      ctx.fillText('• Coqueluche : À JOUR', 60, 290);
      ctx.fillText('• BCG (Tuberculose) : VACCINÉ', 60, 340);
      ctx.fillText('• Rougeole - Oreillons - Rubéole (ROR) : À JOUR', 60, 390);

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#BDC3C7';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(60, 440);
      ctx.lineTo(540, 440);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Official looking doctor stamp
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#27AE60';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeRect(320, 500, 200, 90);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#27AE60';
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('DR. V. GARNIER', 360, 535);
      ctx.font = '12px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Médecin Généraliste', 365, 555);
      ctx.fillText('Certifié conforme', 370, 575);

      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
      const sample: UploadedFile = {
        id: `sample-${Date.now()}`,
        name: 'Copie_Carnet_Vaccinations_Page1.jpg',
        type: 'image/jpeg',
        size: 142000,
        dataUrl,
        uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      onChange([...files, sample]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div id="vaccination-upload-module" className="space-y-4">
      {/* Obligatory alert callout */}
      <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-3 transition-colors ${
        files.length > 0
          ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-950'
          : 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-950'
      }`}>
        {files.length > 0 ? (
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        ) : (
          <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        )}
        <div className="flex-1">
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            Copie du carnet de vaccinations obligatoire
            {files.length > 0 && (
              <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                {files.length} document{files.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} joint{files.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </span>
            )}
          </h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Veuillez joindre obligatoirement une copie lisible de la page des vaccinations du carnet de santé de l’élève (formats acceptés : PDF, JPG/JPEG, PNG). Vous pouvez ajouter plusieurs photos si nécessaire.
          </p>
        </div>

        {files.length === 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={addSampleCarnet}
            className="text-xs bg-white border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-100 font-semibold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg shrink-0 shadow-2xs transition-colors"
          >
            + Exemple de test
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Upload Zone */}
      <div
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragOver(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        className={`border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl p-6 text-center cursor-pointer transition-all ${
          dragOver
            ? 'border-blue-700 bg-blue-50/50 scale-[0.99]'
            : 'border-slate-300 hover:border-blue-900 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50/80'
        }`}
      >
        <input
          ref={fileInputRef}
          type="file"
          multiple
          accept=".pdf,image/png,image/jpeg,image/jpg"
          onChange={(e) => processFiles(e.target.files)}
          className="hidden"
        />

        <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-blue-950 flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
          <Upload className="w-6 h-6" />
        </div>

        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">
          Glissez-déposez la copie de votre carnet ici, ou{' '}
          <span className="text-blue-900 underline">parcourez vos fichiers</span>
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
          Prenez une photo nette avec votre smartphone ou déposez un fichier PDF / Image (max 15 Mo)
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* List of uploaded files */}
      {files.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Documents transmis ({files.length}) :
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-900 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Ajouter une autre page / photo
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {files.map((file, idx) => (
              <div
                key={file.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-2xs hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors"
              >
                {file.type.includes('pdf') ? (
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-blue-900 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 overflow-hidden relative">
                    <img
                      src={file.dataUrl}
                      alt={file.name}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate" title={file.name}>
                    Page {idx + 1} — {file.name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    {Math.round(file.size / 1024)} Ko • {new Date(file.uploadedAt).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPreviewFile(file)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-950 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                    title="Aperçu du document"
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeFile(file.id)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                    title="Supprimer"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Lightbox Preview Modal */}
      {previewFile && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 truncate max-w-md">
                  {previewFile.name}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  {previewFile.type} • {Math.round(previewFile.size / 1024)} Ko
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPreviewFile(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 text-lg font-bold px-2 py-1"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-4 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 min-h-[300px]">
              {previewFile.type.includes('pdf') ? (
                <div className="text-center p-8 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xs">
                  <FileText className="w-16 h-16 text-rose-600 mx-auto mb-3" />
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">Fichier PDF joint</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">{previewFile.name}</p>
                  <a
                    href={previewFile.dataUrl}
                    download={previewFile.name}
                    className="mt-4 inline-block text-xs font-semibold px-4 py-2 bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-800"
                  >
                    Télécharger pour consulter
                  </a>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <img
                  src={previewFile.dataUrl}
                  alt={previewFile.name}
                  className="max-h-[70vh] object-contain rounded-lg shadow-xs"
                />
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex justify-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPreviewFile(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-700"
              >
                Fermer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/types.ts`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/types.ts -->
```typescript
export type SchoolClass = 
  | '6ème A' | '6ème B' | '6ème C' | '6ème D'
  | '5ème A' | '5ème B' | '5ème C' | '5ème D'
  | '4ème A' | '4ème B' | '4ème C' | '4ème D'
  | '3ème A' | '3ème B' | '3ème C' | '3ème D'
  | '2nde 1' | '2nde 2' | '2nde 3' | '2nde 4'
  | '1ère G1' | '1ère G2' | '1ère G3' | '1ère STMG'
  | 'Tale G1' | 'Tale G2' | 'Tale G3' | 'Tale STMG';

export const SCHOOL_CLASSES: SchoolClass[] = [
  '6ème A', '6ème B', '6ème C', '6ème D',
  '5ème A', '5ème B', '5ème C', '5ème D',
  '4ème A', '4ème B', '4ème C', '4ème D',
  '3ème A', '3ème B', '3ème C', '3ème D',
  '2nde 1', '2nde 2', '2nde 3', '2nde 4',
  '1ère G1', '1ère G2', '1ère G3', '1ère STMG',
  'Tale G1', 'Tale G2', 'Tale G3', 'Tale STMG'
];

export const SCHOOL_YEARS = ['2025-2026', '2026-2027', '2027-2028'];

export type VaccinationStatus = 'a_jour' | 'non' | 'non_realise' | 'inconnu';

export interface VaccinationDetail {
  status: VaccinationStatus;
  date?: string;
  comment?: string;
}

export interface UploadedFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  size: number;
  dataUrl: string; // base64
  uploadedAt: string;
}

export interface FicheInfirmerieData {
  id?: string;
  schoolYear: string;
  status: 'brouillon' | 'complete' | 'signee' | 'transmise_nextcloud' | 'erreur_transmission';

  // Section 1 - Identité de l'élève
  eleve: {
    classe: SchoolClass | string;
    nom: string;
    prenom: string;
    dateNaissance: string;
    adresse: string;
    codePostal: string;
    ville: string;
    nomMedecinTraitant: string;
    telMedecinTraitant: string;
  };

  // Section 2 - Personnes responsables
  responsableLegal: {
    nom: string;
    statut: 'pere' | 'mere' | 'responsable_tuteur';
    telPersonnel: string;
    telTravailMere: string;
    telTravailMereNonConcerne: boolean;
    telTravailPere: string;
    telTravailPereNonConcerne: boolean;
  };

  // Section 3 - Personne accident
  urgenceAccident: {
    nomPrenom: string;
    telPersonnel: string;
    telTravail: string;
    telTravailNonConcerne: boolean;
    adresse: string;
  };

  // Section 4 - Santé & Vaccinations
  sante: {
    vaccinations: {
      antipoliomyelitique: VaccinationDetail;
      antidiphterique: VaccinationDetail;
      antitetanique: VaccinationDetail;
      anticoqueluche: VaccinationDetail;
      antituberculeux_bcg: VaccinationDetail;
    };
    carnetVaccinations: UploadedFile[];
    allergiesDifficultesSante: string;
    aucuneAllergie: boolean;
  };

  // Section 5 - Autorisation parentale
  autorisationParentale: {
    soussigneNomPrenom: string;
    qualite: 'pere' | 'mere' | 'autres';
    autreQualitePrecision?: string;
    nomEnfant: string;
    accordPriseEnCharge: boolean;
    accordActesMedicaux: boolean;
    faitA: string;
    faitLe: string;
    signatureDataUrl: string;
    mentionLuEtApprouve: boolean;
    signataireNomComplet: string;
    dateHeureSignature: string;
  };

  // Section 6 - Consentement données de santé (RGPD)
  consentementDonneesSante: {
    accepteCollecteEtTransmission: boolean;
    dateConsentement: string;
  };

  // Nextcloud & Storage Metadata
  nextcloud?: {
    status: 'en_attente' | 'transmis' | 'erreur';
    dossierCible?: string;
```

## `apps/infirmerie/src/utils/apiAuth.ts`

<!-- SCRIPT-START:apps/infirmerie/src/utils/apiAuth.ts -->
```typescript
/**
 * Authentification côté navigateur (build securite-20261011)
 * - Les jetons de session sont gardés EN MÉMOIRE uniquement (rien dans localStorage / sessionStorage / cookies) :
 *   un rechargement de la page demande une nouvelle connexion.
 * - Ils sont récupérés automatiquement dans les réponses de connexion / inscription,
 *   puis joints à chaque appel /api (en-têtes X-Staff-Token / X-Parent-Token).
 * - Une réponse 401 « auth-required » déclenche l'événement 'infirmerie:session-expiree'.
 */
let staffToken: string | null = null;
let parentToken: string | null = null;

export const SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT = 'infirmerie:session-expiree';

export function getStaffToken(): string | null {
  return staffToken;
}

export function clearSession(role: 'staff' | 'parent'): void {
  const token = role === 'staff' ? staffToken : parentToken;
  if (role === 'staff') staffToken = null;
  else parentToken = null;
  if (token) {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    headers[role === 'staff' ? 'X-Staff-Token' : 'X-Parent-Token'] = token;
    window.fetch('/api/auth/logout', { method: 'POST', headers }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

/** Lien de téléchargement direct (<a href>) : le jeton du personnel passe dans l'URL */
export function withStaffToken(url: string): string {
  if (!staffToken) return url;
  return `${url}${url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}token=${encodeURIComponent(staffToken)}`;
}

export function installApiAuth(): void {
  if ((window as any).__infirmerieApiAuth) return;
  (window as any).__infirmerieApiAuth = true;
  const originalFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);

  window.fetch = async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.toString() : (input as Request).url;
    let pathname = url;
    try {
      pathname = new URL(url, window.location.origin).pathname;
    } catch {
      /* chemin relatif */
    }
    if (!pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return originalFetch(input, init);

    const headers = new Headers(init?.headers || (input instanceof Request ? input.headers : undefined));
    if (staffToken && !headers.has('X-Staff-Token')) headers.set('X-Staff-Token', staffToken);
    if (parentToken && !headers.has('X-Parent-Token')) headers.set('X-Parent-Token', parentToken);

    const res = await originalFetch(input, { ...init, headers, cache: 'no-store' });

    // Récupération des jetons émis à la connexion / l'inscription
    const isStaffLogin = pathname === '/api/auth/admin/login';
    const isParentLogin = pathname === '/api/auth/parent/login' || pathname === '/api/auth/parent/register';
    if ((isStaffLogin || isParentLogin) && res.ok) {
      try {
        const data = await res.clone().json();
        if (data && data.success && data.token) {
          if (isStaffLogin) staffToken = data.token;
          else parentToken = data.token;
        }
      } catch {
        /* ignoré */
      }
    }

    if (res.status === 401 && !pathname.startsWith('/api/auth/')) {
      try {
        const data = await res.clone().json();
        if (data && data.code === 'auth-required') {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT));
        }
      } catch {
        /* ignoré */
      }
    }
    return res;
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * Nom de l'établissement — source UNIQUE pour tous les écrans et tous les PDF de la Fiche Infirmerie
 * (build etablissement-central-20261011). Il vient de GET /api/branding, lui-même mis à jour par la
 * gestion centralisée du portail NDM ou par le bouton « Identité & Logo » du tableau de bord.
 */
export const NOM_PAR_DEFAUT = 'Ensemble Scolaire Notre-Dame des Missions';

let nomCourant = NOM_PAR_DEFAUT;
const abonnes = new Set<(n: string) => void>();

export function getSchoolName(): string {
  return nomCourant;
}

/** Version en majuscules (en-têtes officiels, PDF) */
export function getSchoolNameUpper(): string {
  return nomCourant.toLocaleUpperCase('fr-FR');
}

export function setSchoolName(nom: string | undefined | null): void {
  const n = (nom || '').trim();
  if (!n || n === nomCourant) return;
  nomCourant = n;
  document.title = `Fiche Infirmerie Numérique – ${n}`;
  abonnes.forEach((f) => f(n));
}

export function useSchoolName(): string {
  const [nom, setNom] = useState(nomCourant);
  useEffect(() => {
    abonnes.add(setNom);
    setNom(nomCourant);
    return () => {
      abonnes.delete(setNom);
    };
  }, []);
  return nom;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Utility to generate and provide the school logo as a PNG Data URL
 * for both browser UI and jsPDF document generation.
 */

let cachedLogoDataUrl: string | null = null;

export async function getSchoolLogoDataUrl(): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedLogoDataUrl) {
    return cachedLogoDataUrl;
  }

  // Generate a sharp, high-DPI raster representation of the institution logo
  try {
    const width = 400;
    const height = 464;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    if (!ctx) return '';

    // Draw the exact logo vectors on the canvas
    // 1. Blue orbital rings (sphere)
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(200, 190, 160, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0284c7';

    // Ellipses for latitude/longitude orbits
    const drawEllipse = (x: number, y: number, rx: number, ry: number, rot: number, color: string, w: number, alpha: number) => {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.rotate(rot);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = w;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    };

    drawEllipse(200, 190, 155, 45, -0.26, '#0284c7', 3.5, 0.85);
    drawEllipse(200, 195, 145, 40, 0.38, '#38bdf8', 3, 0.8);
    drawEllipse(200, 185, 130, 32, -0.6, '#0ea5e9', 3, 0.8);
    drawEllipse(200, 190, 120, 155, -0.44, '#0284c7', 3.5, 0.85);
    drawEllipse(200, 190, 90, 150, 0.3, '#38bdf8', 3, 0.75);
    drawEllipse(200, 190, 50, 145, -0.15, '#0ea5e9', 3, 0.75);

    // Swirling arcs
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(65, 150);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(98, 60, 260, 50, 345, 140);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(385, 190, 350, 290, 300, 320);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ea5e9';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // 2. Rising Pentecost / Spirit Flames in the Center
    const flameGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(200, 360, 200, 20);
    flameGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fed7aa');
    flameGrad.addColorStop(0.25, '#fb923c');
    flameGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#f97316');
    flameGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ea580c');

    const innerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(200, 360, 200, 100);
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fef08a');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#f59e0b');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#dc2626');

    // Flame outer base
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = flameGrad;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(190, 360);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(175, 310, 185, 260, 192, 230);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(200, 260, 212, 305, 205, 360);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Flame inner base
    ctx.fillStyle = innerGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(196, 360);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(184, 325, 176, 275, 196, 220);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(208, 270, 220, 320, 202, 360);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Middle flame tongues
    ctx.fillStyle = flameGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(198, 285);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(188, 235, 192, 185, 200, 130);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(210, 170, 216, 230, 202, 285);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Upper flame tip
    ctx.fillStyle = flameGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(202, 160);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(198, 110, 200, 60, 203, 16);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(207, 56, 212, 105, 204, 160);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // 3. "Grandir Ensemble" Cursive Script
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
    ctx.font = 'italic 500 48px "Brush Script MT", "Dancing Script", "Caveat", "Segoe Script", cursive, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('Grandir Ensemble', 200, 420);
    ctx.restore();

    cachedLogoDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    return cachedLogoDataUrl;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Logo generation fallback error:', err);
    return '';
  }
}
```
